articles.title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
articles.content: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dex-One2Many:从单一人类演示中学习Dexterous操纵
articles.content_zh: 虽然从一个单一的人类视频中学习非曲直的操控,为昂贵的机器人演示提供了一个有希望的替代办法,但最近许多方法主要模仿展示的运动. 这种严格的运动比对往往将一般化限制在初始对象的姿势,目标姿势,以及没有在视频中显示的抓取. 或者,通过强化学习(RL)发现某项政策,可以进行广泛的概括,但是,如果没有事先的指导,它就会在复杂、多阶段的任务中与高维度的探索作斗争。 为了应对这些结合的概括和探索挑战,我们提出了Dex-One2Many,一个真实到真实的框架,它从一个单一的人类视频中学习到一个笼统的可调和的操纵政策. 我们的关键洞察力是将视频抽象为引导RL的相继场景图,在保持广泛的通俗性的同时,能够有效探索. 图表是不同重置状态取样的基因限制,为每个阶段提供密集的奖励。 由于图表限制关系而不是精确的姿势,这些重置状态覆盖物体的姿势和抓取到视频之外,同时以密集的奖励从它们中初始化每个阶段则保持了探索的短暂和引导. 完全接受模拟训练,Dex-One2Many将零射入真正的多指手. 在五个工具使用和操纵任务中,Dex-One2Many在所见配置中比基线高出6.5%,而其强力的概括将这一差距扩大至71%。

articles.title: Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation
articles.content: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Rubric-CEPR:通过 Reward-Verific化的自我扭曲来进行图像编辑
articles.content_zh: 指导性图像编辑器的能力已经很高,但进一步改进它们仍取决于人编培训对或外部奖励模式。 这种监督费用高昂,可以奖励可能发生的失败:现实的产出可能会使所要求的修改被取消或改变内容,应当保留。 在这项工作中,我们努力改进一个只使用自己世代的经过预先训练的图像编辑器,没有人类编辑的目标或外部训练时间奖励模式. 为此,我们提出了一个名为Rubric-CEPR的自我演变框架,通过一个标有符号的对比编辑-维护奖(CEPR),用内部表示来验证编辑自己的样本. 一名计划员提议从未贴标签的图像中进行结构化编辑指示,编辑员对多个候选编辑进行抽样,对每个候选者进行冷冻批评分数,进行分解的路标检查,用于编辑实现,去除旧状态,以及内容保存,使用编辑员已经曝光的功能. 非补偿性闸门拒绝不可行的考生,通过轻量级适配器训练将最经过验证的候选人蒸馏到编辑器中. 在Quen-Image-Edit上,Rubric-CEPR将ImgEdit从4.36改进为4.60(+5.5%),在对象隔离上获得+24.9%的增益,并转入Gedit-Bench和Complex-Edit. 同样的程序也改进了Step1X-Edit在ImgEdit上的+7.8%. 我们希望我们的方法将成为图像编辑器的坚实基线,这些编辑从自己核实的样本中改进自己。 我们的代码在 $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/ Rubric-CEPR/\text{this上公开 URL( URL) 美元

articles.title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
articles.content: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DreamTrue:行动-忠实机器人世界模式与反事实后训练
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍DreamTrue, 一种多视角、跨表现的机器人世界模型, 对现有机器人数据集进行这种模型的培训面临两个障碍:不精确的校准可能妨碍随后的行动,而对不成功互动的有限覆盖可能使预测偏向于成功的结果。 为了改进横跨各处的行动,我们将动作轨迹转化为图像空间条件,并引入离线几何校准,使这些条件与目标视频一致。 为了扩大互动覆盖范围,我们引入了反事实的后培训,修改了记录的动作轨迹,并在更广泛的动作和接触配置下生成未来的视频. 为了提供这些预测的反馈 而不配对地面真实的未来, 我们构建了一个人类附加说明的视频数据集, 涵盖机器人、物体和交互缺陷, 其分数指导强化学习后培训,使互动结果在物理上更可信。 在AgiBot上,DreamTrue取得了随后最先进的动作,同时将人类评估的相互作用缺陷率从48.12%降低到6.25%. 值得注意的是,我们的模型在"2026年阿吉博特世界挑战"的世界模型赛道中排名第一. 项目网页见https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue。

articles.title: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
articles.content: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 30,000小时的以Ego为中心的视频不教
articles.content_zh: 世界模型为基于物理学的模拟器提供了一种有希望的替代方法,但仍然远远没有实际应用。 我们问他们用30,000小时的数据集 覆盖了1000多个场景类型和14,000个贡献者。 我们没有依赖不透明的下游衡量标准,而是直接根据具有挑战性的分配外基准来评估代理人和对象之间的忠诚。 增加100x的训练数据既能改善两者,又能改善不均:物剂的模型造型良好,而物体的忠诚度仍然很低,而且改善缓慢. 我们显示,剂的增益不需要来自数据, 一个细心的视觉调节设计 与它的一小部分是饱和的, 它让我们可以测量物体的纯度 并发现它的饱和点。 然后我们引入一个监督计划,将容量从场景外观转向物体动力学,提高物体的忠诚度,尽管仍然存在很大的差距。 最后,我们的结论转移到下游人造物模型。 总体而言,我们的结果表明,以自我为中心的规模化数据使模拟代理人接近其极限,同时将其对世界的影响远远落在后面,缩小这一差距将取决于模型是如何训练的,而不仅仅取决于它们看到多少数据。

articles.title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
articles.content: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Ouro World: 将任何3D世界作为千变万化,永无休止地循环的3D电影
articles.content_zh: 最近的3D世界模型生成了光现实主义,可扩展的场景,这些场景在时间上仍然冻结. OuroWorld是一个无面具的框架,将任何静态的3D高斯电镀场景转变成3D影院图:一个动态的场景,有生动,多样的动作从任何角度无缝地循环. 一个视觉语言模型推断出可信的动态,并引导一个视频模型来合成一个参考视频,我们将其提升并完成为多视图视频. 为了从这种不完善的监管中吸取教训,我们提出不一致性-Robust Protect 4DGS:一个傅里叶系列变形场保证通过构建循环,而一个定位在参考视图上的漂流场吸收了交叉视图不一致. 与以前仅限于流体状运动的Eulerian方法不同,我们捕捉到一般变形,物体运动,以及照明变化. 我们引入了无地面真实性评价,涵盖生动性、自然性、环线一致性和场景质量。 在39个重建并生成的场景上,OuroWorld超越了所有基线,赢得了70.8%-99.0%的用户-学习比较. 项目网页:https://ouroworld.userwei.com

articles.title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
articles.content: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界指南:定向目标 程序任务执行世界模式
articles.content_zh: 视频生成器和基于视频的世界模型可以合成可信的视觉轨迹,但长距离的程序任务需要生成来适应实际生产的东西. 一个模型必须根据其生成状态决定下一个动作,执行该动作,并在任务完成时确认. open-loop生成无法适应执行结果,而现有的闭路系统往往依赖于预先训练的执行器或间接验证. 这在决定行动与成功实现行动之间留下了空白。 我们在视觉世界空间中将程序视频生成作为\emph{闭路任务执行}并引入\textbf{WorldGuide}。 仅考虑到初始图像和任务目标,"世界指南"预测一个原子动作,生成相应的视频剪辑,并利用生成的结果来选择下一个动作或终止. 计划者和执行者接受同样的阶梯级程序演示培训:规划者学习从视觉进展中预测下一个原子动作或任务完成,而执行者直接接受实现预测动作的培训. 分级视觉内存保持了跨越长视距执行的状态,并具有限定的历史符号成本. 由于缺乏对联合规划员-执行员培训的分级行动视频监督,我们介绍\textbf{World Guide Beach}:大约59K个分级附加说明的视频,涉及245项任务和27个程序类别。 世界 指南在\textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}上实现了33.33\%任务成功,与29.90\%相比,最近强大的视频模型MiniMax-H3,尽管MiniMax-H3收到参考行动计划,在\textbf{VideoCraft-Bench}上实现了47.69\%任务成功,而MiniMax-H3在目标仅限条件下实现了32.73\%任务成功. 这些结果表明,必须将规划与学习到的执行结合起来,以便制作以目标为导向的程序录像。

articles.title: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniCap Bench:精细音频图像描述的深层评价框架
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)正在迅速向持续的视听推理发展,因此迫切需要暴露其能力限度的评价。 视听字幕是一项理想的诊断任务,然而,目前的基准面临着一种结合的权衡:整封分数提供覆盖而不本地化,局部探测器提供本地化而不覆盖,不受约束的LLM评分带来不稳定. 我们引入了Omni Cap Bench(Omni-Video Caption Basic),这个基准将视听字幕评价重新设定为深层次的诊断框架. OmniCap Bench将预测目标从自由格式文本转换为一组可核查的原子评价单元,跨越三个轨道:实体参考、视觉镜头和音频事件,从而能够用确定性约束检查和本地化的LLM语义比较进行可靠的评分。 Omni Cap Bench在786个注解密集的视频中,有效地区分了MLLM感知错误,包括时间定位故障,身份漂移,跨模式错位,以及幻觉化的描述. 评估前沿的MLLMs揭示了强烈的当地观念,但长视距视听推理薄弱,特别是在身份漂移和跨模式错位方面,为全模式发展提供了精细的路线图。

articles.title: Hybrid Cinematography: Previsualizing and Managing Hallucination Risk in Generative Video Reshooting
articles.content: On a film set, the camera move is committed during a take. Generative video reshooting lets filmmakers change it afterward, but may require hallucinating unrecorded content, a gap sometimes discovered only after leaving the set. We present Hybrid Cinematography, a workflow that bridges physical capture and generative reshooting to manage hallucination risk while filmmakers can still act on it. Using an editable 3D shot plan and a proxy of the take, our previsualization evaluates hallucination risk in real time. Seeing where the take lacks support, filmmakers can iteratively adjust the plan, explore moves that balance capture and generation, shoot guided pickups, or knowingly accept hallucination. We demonstrate the workflow through a mobile augmented reality application for on-set planning, capture, and review, and an offline pipeline for existing video. A study with experienced filmmakers reveals how previsualizing risk informs camera decisions and exposes tensions between creative intent and generative hallucination.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 混合影视:在基因视频重拍中可视化和管理迷幻风险
articles.content_zh: 在电影集中,摄像头动作是在拍摄时进行的. 基因视频重拍让电影制作人事后改变,但可能要求幻觉未录制的内容,这个漏洞有时只在离开剧集后才发现. 我们介绍的是混合电影摄影, 这个工作流程连接 物理捕捉和基因重拍 来管理幻觉风险 而制片人仍然可以采取行动。 利用可编辑的3D镜头计划以及镜头的代名词,我们的预视性实时评估幻觉风险. 看到摄像头缺乏支持的地方,电影制作人可以迭代调整计划,探索平衡捕捉和生成的动作,拍摄引导的皮卡,或者在知情的情况下接受幻觉. 我们通过一个可移动的扩大现实应用软件来展示工作流程,用于设定规划、捕获和审查,以及用于现有视频的离线管道。 与经验丰富的电影制片人进行的一项研究揭示了预视风险如何为相机决策提供依据,并暴露了创作意图和基因幻觉之间的紧张关系.

articles.title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
articles.content: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Brick Bench: 评估代理砖设计
articles.content_zh: 我们提出Brick Bench, 一个具有代理文本条件的LEGO设定设计的基准. 迅速,代理人负责制作一个不仅符合语义和设计标准,而且可以实际建造的组件。 为此,它必须从独立的图书馆中选择部分内容,并就地方和全球制约因素共同提出理由。 我们通过三种不同规模和部分可用性的设置来获得有效性、一致性和设计。 我们提供BrickAgent, 一种环境 编码代理 建造,检查和验证他们的设计。 我们发现,领先的物剂基本上满足了可核查的物理和语义要求,但是没有达到人类的设计. 我们在http://www.brickben.ch上公布了我们的基准和环境。

articles.title: VersaCamVLA: Camera-Configurable VLA Policies for Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful foundations for robotic manipulation, but their reliance on fixed camera configurations during training makes them brittle to changes in camera count or pose during deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose VersaCamVLA, a camera-configurable framework that decouples camera-set representation from action learning. VersaCamVLA learns a unified scene-token interface that maps an arbitrary, variable set of posed RGB views into fixed-size latent scene tokens. This is achieved via multi-signal target-view prediction and Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling (WAPS), which leverages natural wrist-camera motion for free pose diversity. At deployment, a lightweight spatial encoder injects these compact scene tokens into a pretrained base VLA as a supplementary visual condition, requiring no explicit 3D sensing or novel-view rendering. Experiments on RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real-robot platform demonstrate that VersaCamVLA consistently outperforms prior VLA methods and direct multi-view baselines, maintaining robust performance across varying camera counts and unseen camera poses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VersaCamVLA:机器人操纵的相机可配置VLA政策
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型已作为机器人操控的强大基础出现,但它们在训练中依赖于固定的相机配置,使得它们在部署时难以改变相机计数或姿势. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出VersaCamVLA,一个相机配置框架,将相机设定代表与动作学习脱钩. VersaCamVLA学习一个统一的场景切换界面,将一组任意,可变的RGB视图映射到固定大小的潜在场景符号中. 这是通过多信号靶景预测和Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling(WAPS)实现的,它们利用自然腕相机运动来自由摆放多样性. 在部署时,一个轻量级空间编码器将这些紧凑的场景符号注入一个预先训练的基座VLA,作为辅助视觉条件,不需要明确的3D感知或新视觉渲染. 在RoboTwin,LiBERO上的实验和一个真机器人平台显示,VersaCamVLA一贯优于先前的VLA方法和直接的多视基线,在不同的相机计数和看不见的相机姿势上保持强劲的性能.

articles.title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts
articles.content: In this work, we show that a single Transformer block, applied recurrently, can match the accuracy of a full-depth vision encoder at comparable inference FLOPs without intermediate feature distillation. reViT restores depth-specific transformations by representing the FFN at each recurrent depth as a convex combination of a small shared expert bank. A continuous normalized-depth coordinate programs this mixture, defining a resampleable trajectory through FFN parameter space. We evaluate this design in two regimes: supervised ImageNet-1k training and distillation from a DINOv2 teacher. Across both regimes, controlled adaptations identify weight-space merging as the strongest tested MoE family at a matching one-FFN budget, ahead of the token-dispatch and output-mixture alternatives. Trained from scratch, reViT-B/16 attains DeiT III accuracy with about 70\% fewer stored parameters. An 8-experts model distilled using only the teacher's output features retains nearly all of its DINOv2 teacher's linear-probe accuracy and transfers across classification, segmentation, and depth prediction. Elastic-depth training allows one checkpoint (trained model) to operate at multiple tested depths by resampling the same normalized coordinate interval. For fixed-depth deployment, the recurrent block can be materialized as a conventional dense graph, removing online routing and merging without changing the one-FFN-per-depth compute but expanding deployment storage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个块,多深度:有深度方案专家的经常性愿景转换器
articles.content_zh: 在这部作品中,我们显示一个单一的变形器块,反复应用,可以在没有中间特性蒸馏的可比推论FLOP上匹配一个全深视编码器的精度. reViT通过将FFN在每一个经常性深度上代表为小共享专家库的对流组合来恢复深度特定转换. 连续的常态化深度协调程序 这种混合物, 定义可重复的轨迹 通过FFN参数空间。 我们通过两种制度来评价这一设计:监督的ImageNet-1k培训和DINov2教师的蒸馏。 在这两种制度中,受控的适应将重量-空间合并确定为在匹配的单一福尔道网络预算中测试最强的MOE家族,领先于代号分配和产出-混合替代品。 从零开始训练,reViT-B/16获得了DeiT III的精度,存储参数减少约70%. 一个只使用教师输出特性的8位专家模型保留了几乎所有的DINOv2教师的线性测试精度和跨分类、分化和深度预测的转移。 弹性深度训练使一个检查站(训练型号)在多次试验的深度运作,其方式是重印相同的常态坐标间隔. 对于固定的深度部署,经常性块可以实现常规的密集图,去掉在线路由和合并,而不改变每个深度一个FFN但扩展部署存储.

articles.title: LEGO: A Lifting-Free Approach for Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
articles.content: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved. Current state-of-the-art methods reconstruct the scene explicitly by estimating depth, lifting the video into a point cloud, and re-rendering it from the egocentric camera to condition a video diffusion model. This deterministic mapping assigns each pixel to a single reprojected location, which preserves texture but translates depth errors into misplaced content. We ask what a video diffusion model should receive as its condition and propose a lifting-free answer: a learned view synthesizer, an LVSM-style transformer fine-tuned to render the egocentric view directly without depth, point clouds, or reprojection, resolving cross-view correspondence internally. In contrast, its probabilistic mapping averages each region over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, preserving structure while fine texture is averaged away. We argue that this trade-off suits a diffusion generator, whose denoising training excels at restoring detail, so an effective condition should prioritize structural alignment over sharpness. This distribution's concentration also yields a per-region confidence, used both to mask low-confidence regions and to guide the generator toward high-confidence areas during early layout-forming denoising steps. Our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline and generalizes to other datasets without retraining. The synthesizer thus supplies view structure, and the diffusion model its detail.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LEGO:异心对异心的免提方法 视频生成
articles.content_zh: 从一个单一的异心录制中生成一个自我中心视频,是新视觉合成的一个挑战性案例,因为两台相机几乎没有重叠之处,而且许多目标视图都无人观察. 目前最先进的方法通过估计深度,将视频提升到点云中,再从以自我为中心的相机中重新赋予它来对视频传播模型进行条件化,来明确重建场景. 这种确定性映射将每个像素分配到一个单一的重投影位置,这保存了纹理,但将深度错误转换成错误的内容. 我们问视频传播模型应该收到什么作为条件,并提出一个免升空的答案:一个有学识的视图合成器,一个LVSM风格的变压器经过微调,可以直接使以自我为中心的视图没有深度,点云,或者重新投射,解决内部的交叉视图对应. 与此相反,其概率制图根据所学的函授分布,平均衡量每个区域候选来源地点,保持结构,而精细的纹理平均消失。 我们主张,这种权衡应适合传播发电机,这种发电机的授意训练在恢复细节方面非常出色,因此,一个有效的条件应该优先考虑结构调整而不是锐度。 这种分布的集中还产生每个地区的信心,既用来掩盖低信心地区,又用来引导生成者在早期布局化的去诺化步骤中向高自信地区发展. 我们的做法一贯优于最先进的明确管道,并在不进行再培训的情况下向其他数据集概括。 合成器因此供给了视图结构,以及其细节的传播模型.

articles.title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
articles.content: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FastBench: Can 流式 VLMs 透视高动态 真实世界流?
articles.content_zh: 流式视频大语言模型(VLMs)使得视频能够持续理解,然而现有的基准侧重于低动态情景. 在限定的上下文预算下,模型必须平衡时间历史、空间分辨率和时间颗粒性;1-2-FPS的零星采样错过了快速事件。 我们介绍Fast Bench来评估现实世界视频流中高动力感知. 它的轨迹定位管道结合了高FPS剪辑的QA生成,在2 FPS过滤问题答案,使用SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹进行解答验证,以及三轮人类检查. Fast Bench包含跨8个域的306个QA对,6个容量,以及前,即时,落后的时间范围,并带有人附加说明的证据间隔. 我们还提出 " 主动Frame " ,这是一个无培训基线,通过文本符号调整收到的帧率。 双层滑动窗口保留了最近的高FPS观测数据,同时将较老的观测数据降为稀疏的历史。 实验揭示了实质性的局限性:最强的模型双子座3.5-Flash,得分只有50.7%. Denser采样改进了Qwen3-VL-8B,从2 FPS的32.9%提高到24 FPS的44.6%,但随着历史的压缩而增饱和. 主动 框架比稀有的统一取样多5.4和1.5个百分点,但仍远远低于oracle指导重点,表明当需要更精确的时间感知时,目前的VLM就难以从溪流中确定。 Fast Bench为高动力流视频理解提供了测试台. 代码和数据:https://github.com/Ashone3/Fast Bench.

articles.title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
articles.content: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Pumpire:计量距离估计的统一基准
articles.content_zh: 我们提出Pumpire,这是评价图像和视频三维基模型的度量点-平面距离估计能力的一个统一基准,无论是否具有深度。 与以往通常单独评价深度和相机内在的深度或用几何相似度度测量的点-云,不能直接反映模型的点对点距离估计能力的方法相反,Pumpire直接评估点对点距离重建的几何. 为此,我们收集了由100个真实世界场景组成的大规模和多样的数据集(pumpire-6k),每个场景都带有物理测量的点-帕距离,并包含64帧,共计6400帧. 在这个数据集的基础上,我们建立了一个涵盖图像和视频三维基模型的整体评价协议,并能够直接评估点帕距离差错和交叉设置比较. 我们对具有代表性的三维基础模型的29个基线配置进行了广泛的试验,并对结果进行了全面分析。 通过提供这一基准,我们的目标是在重建的三维空间中更基本地认识和估计实际规模,而以前的评估协议基本上忽视了这一点。 项目网页见https://pumpire.github.io/。

articles.title: Beyond Spatio-Temporal Priors: A Generalizable Approach for Dense Correspondence Matching
articles.content: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越斯帕蒂奥-时序: 感官通信匹配的通用方法
articles.content_zh: Dense函式比对在历史上一直以简化spatio-时序前缀为界,例如平滑运动和刚性几何. 这些假设虽然对古典任务有效,但在图像编辑和参考制导生成(IEG)中分解,其中的转换可以在打破物理连续性的同时保留视觉特性. 为了在这种转变中建立保存身份的对应关系,我们引入了FreeMatching,这是一个概括性框架,将基因和语义基础表述与古典数据集、跟踪视频和合成场景的不同监督结合起来。 教师指导的迭代改进进一步改善了IEG中没有密集的函证说明的函证. 在实验中,一个单一的FreeMatching模型极大地提高了挑战IEG图像配对的对应质量,同时保留了经典基准上的竞争性性能. 此外,我们显示,它作为评价身份保护的量化衡量标准,其分数与人类判断相关。 该代码可在https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching上查阅.

articles.title: OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video
articles.content: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL, a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For fine-grained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR. Project repository: https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OneSearch-VL:统一多式联运 图像和视频的深层研究代理
articles.content_zh: 单图像,多图像,视频深层研究需要不同的视觉操作,但共享视觉地面,外部检索,以及事实构成的工作流程. 关键的挑战是如何维持连接本地视觉主播、实体关系、来源支持的事实和生成答案的操作的依赖性。 我们引入了OneSearch-VL,一个以视基证据图(VGEG)为中心的统一代理,将这些依赖性编码为数据构建,过程监督和操作级评价的共同任务级参考. 我们基于VGEG的数据引擎构建并验证多图像和视频问题,过滤专家轨迹. 利用这些数据,我们分别为SFT和RL组装了OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K和OneSearch-VL-RL-10K. 我们进一步从VGEG说明中得出了证据意识的视觉-圆形Rubric奖(EVGR),以监督证据的可追踪性和RL期间的视觉定位。 为了进行精细的评价,我们构建了OneSearch-MI-Bench和OneSearch-Video-Bench,组织在他们的VGEG中编码的研究操作的提问. 实验显示,OneSearch-VL-8B比Quen3-VL-8B改进,在两个新基准上,工具访问率分别提高了20.2%和17.6个百分点,同时在7个图像基准和视频数据库上也取得了显著进展。 项目存放处:https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL

articles.title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WOVEN:将视觉世界模型制作成多式联运有限责任公司
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)与空间,内涵,物理,时间推理发生斗争. 我们假设,这些失败反映了视觉过渡推理方面的共同缺陷,并测试这种能力是否能够作为一个共同的训练原始,一种不同的模型可以从不同的监督来源中学习,并跨不同的任务重复使用,并有系统的培训配方. 现有基准分别记录这些缺陷,但并不支持在场景、行动和推理业务中进行有控制的比较。 因此,我们引入了WOVEN,一个视觉过渡推理的培训来源和基准,通过场景,动作和推理类型来组织过渡监督,使用不同,现实的从视频预修的基因模型展开:共有36,076个实例,涉及20种场景类型,5种动作类型,8种推理类型. 我们首先评价了38种前沿的MLLM(例如GPT-5.4和Qune3-VL-235B-A22B),并发现了一个实质性的系统性的缺陷:即使是最强的模型也远远低于人类,失败在模范家庭之间反复出现,并且以规模持续. 然后,我们在WOVEN上进行多种规模的MLLMs培训,发现它们学会了一种共享的能力,可以广泛转让:培训的子集,每个子集只有大约2 000件,使26个外部基准中的22个提高了27.3个百分点,WOVEN数据可以以可比较的准确性取代任务本身培训数据的30-50%。 控制下的比较进一步为视觉世界的建模提供了培训配方,在被搁置的基准上预先验证:通过它所教的推理操作选择监督,而不是通过它显示的行动、场景或领域选择监督,更倾向于对视觉状态进行更大的改变,以保持稳健。 我们的工作将视觉过渡推理确定为在MLLMs系统化的视觉世界模型培训的可重复使用的基础。

articles.title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
articles.content: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MAMHOI:通过承受能力使场景-认知人类-目标互动因素化
articles.content_zh: 在复杂的3D场景中产生现实的人类-物体相互作用(HOI)需要两种互补能力:关于环境中相互作用可行性的推理和合成现实的人类-物体运动. 然而,对这些能力的监管很少能够大规模地联合提供。 人类空间数据集提供了丰富的环境感知运动信息,而人类物体数据集则捕捉到详细的相互作用动态,然而配对的人类空间数据仍然稀缺. 我们介绍MAMHOI, 一种承受得起的中介因素化 用于场景感知的人类物体交互生成。 MAMHOI通过场景理解与运动合成之间的明确运动-承受力接口,将场景-意识HOI生成要素化:场景-承受力模型首先预言了一种相互作用在何地和如何实际执行,而承担力-承受力-承受力的HOI模型然后产生相应的人-物体运动. 这种因子化使得场景理解和互动动态能够从互补的监督来源中学习,而不需要配对的人体-物体-场景数据. 在复杂的室内环境中进行的实验表明,MAMHOI减少了物体-场景穿透,同时更好地维护了人体-物体相互作用的质量,产生了更现实和物理上可行的场景-感知相互作用. 项目网页:https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/ https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-12-21.

articles.title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
articles.content: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldCast:分布式多人世界模型
articles.content_zh: 多人世界模式必须产生独立控制的观点,双方玩家及其共同环境的表述一致. 大多数现有方法通过联合多视图生成来协调多个玩家,其成本随着每个额外的玩家而增加. 我们介绍WorldCast,一个分布式多人世界模型,其中每个玩家运行一个由视频生成器和一个状态模型组成的本地客户端. 在训练期间使用记录的玩家位置和地图几何,状态模型通过生成的视频和控制输入来估计玩家的位置. 客户端交换玩家状态,并将其投射到相机对齐的玩家状态域,以指导其他玩家的提供地点和方式. 共享的场景状态使客户端能够重新使用彼此生成的观测数据,以保持场景在视图间的一致性. 反冲击2号的实验演示了世界卡斯特公司的一致性,实时性能,以及分布式的可伸缩性. 相机对齐的玩家状态场比联合生成方法提高玩家的渲染率,比数量级以上,而共享场景状态则提高整个回合的视觉一致性. 每个客户端实时运行,并只交换玩家和场景状态,使得可扩展的多人生成没有集中计算瓶颈. 图像质量在长达一小时的推出期间保持稳定。

articles.title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
articles.content: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LeWAM:一个JEPA世界行动模式,其传播-搜索-基于MPC
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)预测行动和未来观测,一般来自一种基于重建的表述,其中包含着吵闹的,多余的信息,可能使下游预测复杂化. 我们介绍LeWAM, 一个双向变换器, 用于前向、后向、逆向动态和政策预测, 我们看到以下好处: 1)对齐:线性探测器从LeWAM的潜伏状态读取机器人和物体状态,比普通的Le World Model(一种仅前置的JEPA世界模型)要好得多,而潜伏状态则忽略了视觉分散器以及LeWM所做的,远胜于基于重建的WAM. 2) 代理:对LEWAM的闭路评价与一个定期的流量匹配政策相匹配,该政策在相应大小的同一编码器上接受培训,同时也提供了一个世界模式。 3)规划:在与WAMs进行规划时对原始行动进行抽样,让MPC利用动态模型不准确;在政策头的噪声空间进行规划反而改善这些WAMs的闭路性能.

articles.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
articles.content: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ViSkill:增强VLM代理,增强视觉-自然技能
articles.content_zh: 技能强化剂通过将成功的轨迹蒸馏成可重复使用的策略,提高样本效率. 然而,大多数现有方法仍然以文字为中心,将空间布局和动作状态对应线化,变成失去几何结构的语言。 最近的努力已开始纳入视觉证据,但将技能建设和更新与政策优化分开,使相互改进的情况没有得到充分利用。 我们提出ViSkill,这是一个视觉-内在技能学习框架,将成功的交互编码为VLM代理直接访问的复合视觉技能卡. 获取的技能指导推论和奖励塑造,而成功的轨迹则被提炼回图书馆,形成闭塞的反馈循环,其中技能积累和政策改进相互加强. 可选的冷启动机制进一步加快了早期学习. 通过对Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill的评价,ViSkill取得了0.89的总体成功率,通过冷启动初始化,上升至0.91,比所有评估的专有和开源基线都好,同时比标准的PPO更快聚合。 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill上找到.

articles.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpaceCast-Bench:评价远景-语言模型中的预测空间理由
articles.content_zh: 现有空间推理基准主要测试空间感知:读取输入中已经可见的关系. 然而,现实世界的空间智能需要预测空间推理:从观测中构建一个场景,预测干预如何改变它,以及对看不见的结果进行推理. 我们介绍了SpaceCast-Bench,这是直接和诊断性地评估这种能力的第一个基准。 围绕一个观测-变形法框架,182个真实世界场景的3862个问题涉及16个任务类型,分三个层面:静态感知、局部预测和全球预测,逐步需要场景理解、空间状态更新以及对未观测结果的关联推论。 评估21种模型暴露出一个明显的差距:最强模型只达到58.0%,而人类的性能为87.2%,而空间专用模型仍然接近随机机会. 受控制的分析进一步表明,桥梁观点对综合分布式观测至关重要,明确的立体证据模型比生成的结果图像或视频更可靠。 微调我们方案生成的数据,将Qune3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%,在六个领域外基准中实现宏观平均收益。

articles.title: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
articles.content: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpaceFlow: 本地可控三维生成
articles.content_zh: 目前3D生成方法缺乏明确的局部控制:几何坚持度常由全局控制强度定义,外观无法在局部指定. 我们介绍SpaceFlow,这是用于本地可控制3D生成的无训练管道,来自文字描述和几何原始物的集合. 每个原始物都充当一个对象部分的代名词,并被分配到一个局部控制级别,使用户能够明确区域是应该严格遵循输入形状,还是允许基因完成. 在结构生成过程中,我们在基因流过程中强制执行这些空间限制。 对于外观合成来说,生成的结构是分化的,并与原始物匹配. 每个生成的部分仅以其指定的文字或图像提示为条件,从而限制跨部分的渗漏. 区域几何测量标准表明,SpaceFlow在高控制区域保留了指定的几何特征,并使得低控制区域有合理的形状变化。 一项用户研究进一步指出,在几何忠诚度和基因自由度之间所产生的平衡在整体质量上仍然是竞争性的。 在评价固定几何上的外观时,文字条件的路由实现了最先进的即时的忠诚度和颜色/材料的准确性. 定性结果还显示图像提示的局部路径。 项目网页可在SpaceFlow3D.github.io查阅。

articles.title: GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment
articles.content: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GNIA: 试-时输入对齐的基因重建
articles.content_zh: 从单一或稀疏的多视图观测中重建完整的3D对象资产仍然具有挑战性. 基因3D基础模型可以超越观测到的观点完成对象几何,但其预测可能无法忠实地复制观测到的几何,外观,或姿势. 我们引入了GenIA,一个测试-时间输入-对流生成的框架,这个框架在几何和光度观测中先基于SAM3D的基因,而不对基础模型进行再培训. 我们通过从几何学中推导出翻译和尺度来改进对象的姿势,同时保留先前学到的旋转,并通过对可见度的有偏见的注意、交叉观测聚变和在消音时不同的渲染指导来调整外观。 一种可选的外观隐蔽后改进方法进一步使外观潜伏,轻量级的解码器适配器,以及物体的放置适应观测. 我们的框架还支持外部提供的几何学;当给定动态物体的时间形状时,它会恢复一个共享的,输入对齐的光舟外观和稳定的世界空间布局. 从合成和真实的基准来看,GenIA改进了从单元、多视图和动态输入的预测和对象重建,优于最近基于优化的每帧图像到3D和视频到4D的方法。 我们的项目网页可在https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA上查阅。

articles.title: WorldAlign: Decoupled 4D Reward for World-Consistent Video Generation
articles.content: Faithful visual world simulation requires generated videos to maintain 4D world consistency, encompassing both static and dynamic consistency. Static consistency requires coherent 3D structure in static environments across viewpoints, while dynamic consistency requires plausible subject motion and consistent appearance over time. Geometry-aware post-training offers a promising way to improve world consistency. However, existing methods often rely on a static-scene assumption. Even those that accommodate dynamic scenes struggle to provide reliable static-consistency feedback, while dynamic consistency is often overlooked or inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldAlign, a decoupled 4D reward framework that semantically separates static regions and dynamic subjects and provides feedback by aligning each with a world prior suited to its assumptions. For static regions, WorldAlign aligns static geometry with a geometric world prior through semantically guided masked reprojection, enabling more reliable static-consistency evaluation; an auxiliary camera-motion reward discourages nearly static solutions. For dynamic subjects, WorldAlign uses a strong vision-language model (VLM) as a dynamic world prior and constructs a VLM-as-a-judge reward based on sample-specific checklists that assess dynamicity, physical plausibility, shape, and texture consistency. This decoupled design enables more effective online post-training without requiring human preference annotations. Across two pretrained image-to-video generators, Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, WorldAlign jointly improves static and dynamic consistency over existing methods without suppressing overall or subject motion. These results support decoupled world-prior alignment for more faithful visual world simulation. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldAlgnation: 解码四维奖,用于世界统一视频生成
articles.content_zh: 忠实的视觉世界模拟需要生成的视频来保持4D世界的一致性,包括静态和动态一致性. 静态一致性要求在各种观点的静态环境中形成一致的三维结构,而动态一致性则需要合理的主题运动和长期一贯的外观。 几何认识后培训为改进世界一致性提供了一个有希望的途径。 然而,现有方法往往依赖于静态假设. 即使那些容纳动态场景的场景也难以提供可靠的静态一致性反馈,而动态一致性往往被忽略或评估不充分. 为了解决这些局限性,我们引入了WorldAlign,这是一个脱钩的4D奖励框架,它将静态区域和动态主题分解开来,并通过将每个区域与一个先适合其假设的世界相协调来提供反馈. 对于静态区域,WorldAlign将静态几何学与之前的几何世界相协调,通过有成像引导的蒙面再投射,从而能够进行更可靠的静态一致性评价;辅助相机动作奖励会阻止近乎静态的解决方案. 对于动态主体,WorldAlign使用强大的视觉语言模型(VLM)作为动态世界前身,并根据评估动态性、物理可信度、形状和纹理一致性的样本特定清单构建VLM-as-a判断奖励. 这种脱钩的设计可以使在线后培训更加有效,而不需要人的偏好说明。 在Wan2.1和Wan2.2两个预先训练的图像到视频生成器上,WorldAlign联合改进了与现有方法相比的静态和动态一致性,不抑制整体运动或主题运动。 这些结果支持了脱钩的世界前调,以更忠实的视觉世界模拟. 项目网页:https://worldalign.github.io/.

articles.title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
articles.content: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AgentGarten: 演化代理人的代码世界
articles.content_zh: 互动虚拟世界让代理商通过探索和互动学习. 物剂可以学习的是他们所实践的环境,这种环境必须是忠实的,有一致的状态,规则,和动态的,现实的,有跟随现实世界视觉分布的观察. 跨越不同世界实现这两个目标仍然是一个瓶颈。 我们引入了AgentGarten,这个框架让夫妇模拟器和游戏引擎使用共享神经渲染器来构建实时互动环境. 它的模拟后端维持持续的世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则,而渲染器则通过共同的接口输出结构化条件的视觉观测. 为了构建神经渲染器,我们根据几何条件调整了预先训练好的视频模型,用我们提议的Aversarial Forcing来提炼,并优化了实时交互的推论. 逆向强制通过精确的重播使历史预填可以不同,因此后期预测的损失可以更新渲染器如何编码先前的观测,并增加真实数据对抗性监督以提高其视觉质量. 在Agent Garten中,特工通过视觉观察来感知世界,与它实时互动,并通过将每轮经验提炼成随后特工继承和精炼的游戏本来改进. 我们的经验研究表明,学习效率大有提高,只有四轮的教学人员才能学习,而传统的强化学习人员则只有数百万人学习。 由于新世界可以被写成代码,并通过相同的界面渲染,环境可以同时在数量和难度上与它们的代理人一起进行规模化,这是向通过互动经验不断演变的代理人迈出的一步.

articles.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.content: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 健美的图灵机:机器人递归自我改进的国家代码
articles.content_zh: 大多数机器人政策将一个模型保留在控制循环中:一个VLA映射对动作的观察,以及一个代理Harness,如Agent-as-Policy或Harness VLA查询一个VLM,用于运行时的决策. 我们提出一个不同的观点: 所体现世界是一台健美的图灵机, 它的磁带是机器人,环境状态和规则是政策。 如果这个状态可以被精确地表示,决策可以完全用代码书写. 因此,我们提出 " 仅按部就班 " (Code-Only-As-Policy)(COAP):从摄像头的图像和自控角度对机器人、环境和任务状态进行编码和跟踪,并从中作出每一项决定。 同一代码适用于各集,不同的任务共享一个库,循环中没有VLM或VLA. 与VLA和Agent Harneses相比,我们分析COAP的三个优点是:(一) 明确状态:状态可以存储在代码中;(二) 执行:代码使决策可以控制,从失败中灵活恢复,并在网上快速廉价运行;(三) 广泛性:新任务再利用,继承,或扩展共享库,因此能力可以累积在任务之上. 这些优点使得COAP成为了递归自我改进(RSI)的合适介质:编码代理在闭环中开发库,每个变化都是明确的,可以控制的. 在RoboDojo的42个双人任务上,由此产生的库在测试时间没有模型的情况下成功率达到70.24%. COAP的上限在于国家对于决策的表述有多准确,代码逻辑有多强. 因此,我们提议将COAP作为包含的任务的新范式;由于它适用于不同事件,它也可以作为VLA和Agent Harneses的有效数据引擎.

articles.title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
articles.content: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HANS: 无声混合文档解析的手写答题表数据集
articles.content_zh: 智能分级和自动评分技术是智能教育的关键基础设施。 然而,现有的文件解析和笔迹识别基准主要是为结构完善的印刷文件或孤立的数学表达式设计的,缺乏能够反映学生答题表内在的复杂特征的数据集,包括多行推导过程,文字和数学公式的异样混合物,以及噪声文物,如罢课. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了HANS,这是第一个为现实世界的教育情景而明确构建的数据集,包括数学表达、自然语言文本、手绘表格以及各种噪音模式,包括校正和删除,并附有精细的说明,为有力的识别研究奠定可靠的基础。 在HANS的基础上,我们提议NA-GOT,一种端到端的框架,通过在特征一级运行的轻量级噪声抑制模块实现两阶段噪声抑制,并辅之以纳入解码阶段的噪声感应注意机制. 实验结果表明,HANS对现有方法构成重大挑战,而NA-GOT在准确性和稳定性方面对答案过程识别都取得了显著改善。 数据集将在公布后公布。

articles.title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 远景-语言模型中空间原因的分路3D特权
articles.content_zh: 空间推理仍然是视觉语言模型(VLMs)的长期弱点,因为RGB输入不能直接提供几何证据. 现有的补救办法要么在模型中注入3D,推论中支付建筑和耐久费用,要么进行只监督最后答案的结果奖励培训。 空间误差起源于感知:误判的深度或方向只能通过场景的真实几何来纠正,3D扫描的空间训练来源corpora已经提供. 我们提出GPD(Geometry-Priviled Distillation),使几何证据成为政策上自我沉淀的特权(OPSD). 对于每个问题,深度,语义,和鸟眼视(BEV)的提示作为紧凑的文本提供,并和参考答案一起路由给老师;一个特权的KL,仅适用于不正确的轨迹,增强GRPO,部署的模型仍然只有RGB. 在4B主干线上,GPD在VSI-Bench上实现了57.1,在MindCube,SPARBench,MMSI-Bench和ViewSpatrial上实现了平均37.6,在跨空间推理基准上都优于GPRO和答案偏好OPSD. 缩写证实了3D和回答特权的互补性,问题有条件的路由相对于全文本注射的优势,以及将蒸馏限制在不正确的轨迹的好处.

articles.title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
articles.content: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 原因- 成形视觉编辑
articles.content_zh: 大型多式联运模型(LMMs)在视觉理解和生成方面取得重大进展,但在视觉编辑方面仍然面临挑战,特别是在遵循复杂指令,保持外观一致性,支持灵活输入格式方面. 为了研究这一差距,我们引入了RISE Bench,这是评价Reasoning-Informed viSual edit(RISE)的第一个基准,并扩展至RISE Bench++,这是这项新兴任务的更加全面和精细的基准. RISE Bench++ 将分类法扩展为涵盖六个推理维度的分级方案: Temperor, Causal, Space, Logical, 和反事实理性, 以及混合理性, 将多个推理类型整合到多回合编辑中. 这些维度被进一步分解为12个亚类和65个细纹任务类型. 我们扩大输入格式,以包括多图像调制,将基准扩大到1000个人类附加说明的测试案例,以英文和中文发布。 我们还改进我们的评价框架,评估指令合理性、外观一致性和与人类法官的视觉清晰度,以及更可靠和校准判决的LMM-as-judge方法。 除了制定基准外,我们还引入了RISE代理,这是一个无培训代理框架,将推理驱动的规划、工具强化的执行以及核查指导的完善结合起来,在各种RISE任务中表现优于现有最强有力的方法。 我们评价58种视觉编辑方法,包括34种开源模型,19种闭源模型,5种代理方法. 结果显示,基于推理的视觉编辑面临巨大挑战,甚至最强的评价方法是GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst,其准确度仅达到56.6%. RISE Bench++强调了当代编辑模型的局限性,提供了洞察力,并指明了推理意识视觉编辑的未来方向.

articles.title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
articles.content: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ContiLNN:缓解切片取样断续续的液态神经网络,用于医疗图像修复
articles.content_zh: 解剖连续性为医疗图像修复提供了补充信息,但其使用需要考虑局部解剖学和切片采样的变化. 我们引入了ContiLNN,它用双向闭式连续时间(Bi-CfC)模块来增强二维恢复主干线,用于交叉切片模型,同时保留飞机中的特性提取. 切片-索引间隔调节由本地特征和隐藏状态决定的门,使传播能够在没有数字ODE集成的情况下对取样变化作出反应。 参照制式一致性将第一阶和第二阶的交叉切片强度差异协调起来,以保持解剖变异,而冷冻骨干中的蒸馏有助于保持飞机中的忠诚。 在五种训练种子中,ContiLNN分别将PSNR比RWKV改进0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB,用于CT解毒、核磁共振超分辨率和减数PET恢复,在所有三项任务中RMSE都较低。 CT结果对于一个被搁置的病人来说是描述性的. PET分解支持命令传播超过额外点定能力。 在毗连式训练下,Bi-CfC的忠诚度高于具有类似参数计数和计算成本的Bi-GRU在所有测试取样条件下的忠诚度。 匹配的七片剖面显示比Bi-GRU低52.8%的延迟度和57.0%的峰值GPU内存使用率. 混合差距培训使两个操作人员的工作表现更加简陋和不规则,没有在衡量尺度和背景上进行统一的排名。 训练病人较少的实验和第二个骨干进一步支持数据效率和骨干兼容性.

articles.title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
articles.content: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RiCo:通过局部接触模拟硬体-Body相互作用
articles.content_zh: 精确模拟硬体相互作用对于预测物理世界模型至关重要。 尽管最近在建立物体动态模型方面取得了进展,但捕捉到表面形状物体运动之间的局部接触仍然具有挑战性。 虽然端对端世界模型预测整个场景或物体之间的相互作用,但在实践中,刚性的身体接触是内在局部的,只有附近的表面才能直接交换接触力. 基于这一观察,我们引入了Ridid-body Contact Reasoning(RiCo),它代表了物体之间通过接触面点的稀疏的邻里进行的相互作用. RiCo将每个点的状态与附近表面的相对几何,运动,和物理属性结合起来,然后在物体的点之间找出原因来确定这些局部接触如何共同影响其运动. 通过将交叉对象推理限制在附近的表面,同时在每个刚性体内传播接触信息,RiCo保留了精细的刻度互动细节,而无需花费每对场景点的建模成本. 此类属性使RiCo具有更高的准确性和接触忠诚性. MOVi-beckmark上的实验表明,与基线相比,RiCo将100帧位置和方向误差分别减少31-35%和约38%. 此外,RiCo实现了高度接触忠诚,地面-相对渗透时间和平均深度分别为11.0%和2.22毫米。 RiCo进一步将零镜头从小规模训练场景概括到包含270个物体的场景. 我们的现实世界的多球碰撞实验进一步提供了模拟到实际转移的初步证据.

articles.title: Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance
articles.content: Recent motion generative models have demonstrated strong capabilities in synthesizing physically plausible character motion, but often overlook established animation principles used by professional animators to ground and design their animation work. Understanding and incorporating these principles into motion generative pipelines is essential for producing motions that serve not only physically grounded applications but also the needs of the character animation community. This enables the creation of characters that not only move in physically plausible ways but also feel alive, expressive, and engaging. To close this gap, we focus on the Exaggeration principle of animation and investigate how it can be incorporated into modern motion generative pipelines to produce more expressive character motions. To this end, we introduce a framework that operates at two stages of existing motion generative pipelines. The first stage introduces exaggeration during training, where we perform supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained text-to-motion models on our curated exaggeration dataset. The second stage operates at inference time, where we: (i) introduce a mathematical formulation of exaggeration based on dynamic movement primitives (DMPs); and (ii) leverage this formulation as an exaggeration guidance signal to guide existing diffusion and flow-matching text-to-motion generation models toward exaggerated motion without additional training. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations against three strong motion generation models, we show that our methods generate more exaggerated and expressive motions while preserving neutral reference motion intent and physical plausibility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过培训-时间适应和推论-时间指导,对基因运动模型进行可控夸大
articles.content_zh: 最近的运动基因模型在合成物理上可行的性格运动方面表现出了强大的能力,但往往忽略了专业动画师用于地面和设计其动画作品的既定动画原理. 理解这些原则并将其纳入运动基因管道,对于产生不仅符合实际应用而且符合人物动画界需要的运动至关重要。 这使得人们能够创造出不仅以貌相的方式移动,而且能感觉到生命力、表现力和接触力的人物。 为了缩小这一差距,我们侧重于动画的夸张原则,并研究如何将其融入现代运动基因管道,以产生更多表达性格运动. 为此,我们引入了一个框架,在现有运动基因管道的两个阶段运作。 第一阶段在培训期间引入夸大,在培训过程中,我们在我们整理的夸大数据集上对经过事先训练的文字到动作模型进行有监督的微调。 第二阶段是在推论时间运行的,我们:(一) 引入基于动态运动原始(DMP)的夸张的数学配体;和(二) 利用这种配体作为夸张指导信号,引导现有的传播和流配文本到运动生成模型向夸张运动方向发展,而无需额外训练. 通过针对三个强运动生成模型的定性和定量评价,我们显示,我们的方法产生更夸大和表现性的运动,同时保持中立的参考运动意图和物理可信性。

articles.title: Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?
articles.content: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 国内培训是否足以使精细的工业异常理解?
articles.content_zh: 一个单一的多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)在多式联运工业异常理解(MM-IAU)中难以同时在检测、本地化、描述和推理方面表现优异。 我们显示,国内培训无法弥合这一差距。 在MMAD上,一个广泛采用的MM-IAU基准,训练有素的专家在缺陷本地化方面达到最多75.5%的准确度,而人类专家达到92.3%,甚至发现的异常比未经过训练的基础模型更准确。 与此同时,不同的 MLLMs 提供了互补的优势,但在精致的感知中分享了这一弱点,因此单独结合它们无法消除它. 因此,我们提出SiGMA, 一种基于空间的多代理框架, 将劳动分为多种 MLLM 代理和一个专门的视觉缺陷专家。 多式联运搜索器提供工业知识和正常的参考,缺陷专家将查询参考比较转化为校准的异常证据,无标签的可靠性控制器根据任务能力和查询级证据质量对每个来源进行权衡. SiGMA在MMAD上达到85.2%的平均精度,比最强的训练有素的专家和双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双双子双子双子双子双子双子双子双双双双双双双 即使有最多3个9B参数的代理,它也达到了84.4%,新的MLLMs加入时没有再培训.

articles.title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
articles.content: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预算Pix:用于像素-空间图像扩散的计算-可移动切换
articles.content_zh: 大多数图像生成模型都依赖于统一的符号化,将完全相同的计算预算分配给同样大小的图像补丁. 这种静态模式无法在推论时适应不同的资源制约,通过对简单背景和复杂细节的同样努力,产生低于最佳的质量成本权衡。 我们提出预算Pix,这是一个适应性符号化框架,根据视觉复杂度和空间布局动态分配计算,从而能够在推论时间进行灵活的计算预算编制. PresidentPix包含三个关键组成部分:(1)一个适应性的编码器,将固定大小的图像映射到可变长度的符号序列上,使用一个Entropy-guided virtre与一个多尺度的补丁嵌入器并列;(2)一个规模感知的解码器从多尺度的符号集中重建固定分辨率的图像;(3)一个灵活的培训和取样时间表,使像素-空间代号能够跨变量的符号计数运行. 预算Pix与现有的像素-空间传播架构无缝融合,使得一个单一的检查点可以在广泛的计算预算上运行. 对文本到图像生成进行评估后,预算Pix只使用原计算预算的25%,将MiniT2I-L的忠诚度与512^2美元和PixelDiT的忠诚度相匹配。 在使用MeanFlow主干线的类条件生成中,预算Pix只需要完全计算预算的60%就可以产生质量接近零降解的图像,观察到FID的边际0.8点增长. 人文和VLM法官的全面评估证实,Patric Pix比以往的预算调整基线大大改进了质量效率权衡。 更多详情见我们的项目网页:https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix。

articles.title: From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs
articles.content: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms. To address this question, we introduce OTTER, a lightweight supervised probe over frozen MLLM representations that uses Optimal Transport (OT) to align generated tokens with visual regions and produce compact grounding maps. Our results show that (i) instance-discriminative visual information can be decoded from modifier tokens, with the clearest evidence for spatial terms, but (ii) is not confined to them, as contextualized object nouns also carry referential information; (iii) the recovered grounding remains informative under context perturbations, while selected regions remain relevant to generation; and (iv) the learned OT-based grounding extends beyond the controlled setting to free generation and cross-dataset transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从何到何: 解码修改器在冰冻的 MLLMs 中搁浅
articles.content_zh: 由于多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以描述越来越复杂的视觉场景,象征级的地面定位变得至关重要. 然而,当一个MLLM生成"左边的黄香蕉"时,既定的打地方法侧重于图像中的内容("香蕉"),俯瞰一些能帮助描述哪个实例("黄色","左")的标志. 在这项工作中,我们询问被冻结的MLLM表示是否包含可解码的关于所生成符号的被引用实例的基础信息,是否延伸至诸如属性、空间表达和关系/行动术语等修改者。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了OTTER,这是一个对冷冻的MLLM表示的轻量级监督探测器,使用优化运输(OT)使生成的信号与视觉区域一致,并制作紧凑的地面图。 我们的结果表明,(一) 实例-区别视觉信息可以从修改符号中解码,其中空间术语证据最清楚,但(二) 不仅限于这些符号,因为背景化的物体名词也带有偏好信息;(三) 在环境扰动下,恢复的地面仍然具有信息性,而选定的区域仍然与生成相关;(四) 所学的基于OT的地面超越了控制环境,延伸到自由生成和跨数据集传输。

articles.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
articles.content: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有精致互动的多代理Egocent世界模型
articles.content_zh: 爱果中心世界模型预测第一人称观测,以一个代理的动作为条件,但大多侧重于单个代理. 真正的体现环境往往涉及在共同环境中采取行动和互动的多个代理人。 现有的多代理世界模型依赖于诸如运动,相机控制,或离散指令等粗糙动作,留下精细的纹理内含的相互作用被低估. 我们形成了以多代理自我为中心的世界模式,作为在共同世界中通过精细行动进行互动的多种代理的同步自我流生成。 这需要交叉视角行动的一致性、共享环境的一致性,以及互动引起的状态更新的持续传播。 我们提出多代理Egocent World Model(ME-World), 共同将多条自负流以共同的象征顺序呈现出来, 我们训练和评估真实的和合成的多剂数据,并为环境、更新和身份一致性引入共享世界一致性指标。 实验显示ME-World比现有方法提高了共享世界的一致性,动作控制,身份保存和视频质量.

articles.title: Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
articles.content: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it.
