We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Slot3R: 三维重建的集成空间内存
articles.content_zh: 流式3D重建必须从每个框架保存证据,同时在线处理一个不断扩大的场景. 空间记忆是一种自然的适合,因为它通过重建3D位置来组织历史. 然而,Point3R使用空间近距离,既将新的观测与现有的内存条目联系起来,又决定是否将其引信化,将同一位置与状态特征混为一谈。 由于指针对图像补丁进行总结,附近的指针可能编码不同的表面,视线,或可见性条件;平均的指针可以破坏补充证据,然后框架将其分解. 我们主张,地点应确定地址,而不是观察是否必须合并。 Slot3R意识到这一原则是免费的,设定的关联性改造,让多个州在一个共享的地址共存,同时保持预先训练的Point3R骨干冻结. 每帧解码器访问中,一个范围有限的读数进一步脱钩持续存储。 在300-500的采样帧上,Slot3R将Point3R的点云精度误差(Acc)在7Scenes上减少57.1%-63.1%,在NeuralRGBD上减少64.0%-72.0%,将Sim(3)对齐的绝对轨迹误差(ATE)在全部三个都设置了基准,在视频深度估计上保持竞争力. 它在同一协议下完成大约19个FPS的600至1000个抽样帧的所有评价设置,而Point3R和InfiniteVGGT则在800帧及以后耗尽内存.

articles.title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
articles.content: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DVD:高效基于 MLLM 的图像的动态矢量解码
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型在连接视觉和语言方面取得了显著进展,促进了对人机互动、机器人和自主驾驶至关重要的各种感知任务。 然而,现有的基于 MLLM 的感知方法主要依赖于文本的坐标表示法,它受到过量的象征性间接费用,或者固定距离的量化,它受到范围和精确性的限制,特别是对于空间范围无限制和本地化精度要求高的3D域来说. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种名为DVD的动态矢量解码方法,它统一了2D和3D感知任务的表示. 具体地说,我们首先将不同的感官表示(即2D边框,2D口罩,3D边框)转换成1D向量序列,然后在高维空间将它们映射成紧凑的离散符号. 然后,一个轻量级的去tokenizer通过将输出符解码回原2D和3D的感知表示器,实现了与MLLM的无缝融合. 包括RefCOCO系列,SUN-RGBD,KITTI,Hypersim,nuScenes在内的2D和3D感知基准的广泛实验表明,DVD在2D和3D任务中实现了优异的性能,并显著降低了象征性间接费用和推论延迟性. DVD为将感知能力融入MLLM(英语:MLLM)提供了一个高效和一般的框架,克服了现有方法的固有局限性.

articles.title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
articles.content: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Syn-Omni:结构化专门化和逐步合作,用于模拟嵌入
articles.content_zh: 嵌入模式自然涉及各种投入的共同表述和模式的具体特点。 然而,现有的全模式嵌入方法往往依赖于一个共享的参数空间而不是混合模式数据,限制了通用和特定模式代表之间的结构分离。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立Syn-Omni,一个统一框架,以便通过模式专业化和有控制的跨模式协作来进行结构化的全模式调整。 具体来说,我们引入了Orthogonal Modality-Expert LORA(OME-LORA),它将适应分解为通用语义的共享LORA路径和模式-专家LORA路径,用于模式-意识专业化. 此外,逐步协同运行(PSR)使专家能够首先确定特定模式的前科,然后逐步与其他模式专家互动,实现跨模式协同。 对81项涉及图像、视频、音频和视听模式的不同任务进行了评估,Syn-Omni的业绩始终高于所有模式基准,显示了结构化专业化和跨模式渐进合作的有效性。

articles.title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
articles.content: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoVoice:来自Egocentral多式联运流的主动助词
articles.content_zh: 可穿戴的增强现实(AR)助理正在走向持续的现实世界互动,他们通过第一人称视频和音频来感知用户的活动,并在没有明确要求的情况下及时提供口头指导. 虽然主动的视频助理,口语对话系统,以及以自我为中心的任务理解,每个系统都迅速进步,但现有的系统并没有解决决定何时说话和从连续的第一人称流中说什么的共同问题. 我们介绍了EgoVoice,这是一个培训和评估主动自我中心语言助理的框架。 从HoloAssist真实的人类教官的视频录音中,我们通过源头分离和语音合成来构建干净的音频流,并将每段视频会话转换成一种格式,模型必须在每一时刻决定是保持沉默还是提供口头指导. 我们用我们的数据微调一个全方位LLM,并进一步改进它的主动干预行为,直接优化偏好。 跨越封闭式和开源式模型的实验表明,现有的系统很少产生时机成熟,有意义的主动干预,而EgoVoice则在干预时间,内容相关性,以及人类偏好于零镜头主干线方面产生明显的改善.

articles.title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
articles.content: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从提示到构建: 用于海报生成的空间帆布界面
articles.content_zh: 文本提示是海报生成的间接界面,要求用户将固有的二维组成意图编码为单维词序. 我们引入了一个空间扫描仪接口,使用户能够通过四个互补的绑定类型,即语义、身份、文本和像素,以及单个元素和全局外观的文本规格,直接对空间中的生成意图进行编译。 基于这一接口,我们开发了Compo,一种从经过预先训练的图像编辑模型中改编的海报生成模型,以理解空间扫描仪输入和文本规格. Compo既支持用户明确构建画布的直接推论,也支持代理模式,高级请求会自动转换成计划中的空间摄像头. 为了培训Compo,我们开发了一个可伸缩的管道,自动构建不同捆绑类型及其组合的监督数据,从而在不从零开始培训专用海报生成器的情况下,实现高效的适应。 我们还采用了一个基准,评价遵守个别约束性类型的情况及其共同构成。 实验表明,Compo在保持高视觉质量的同时,比通用图像生成模型和专用海报生成系统都更能实现更强的成分控制. 通过将意图规格与视觉生成脱钩,我们的工作将海报生成从催化转向组合。

articles.title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
articles.content: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VibeEdit: 带有 Canvas 指令的图像编辑
articles.content_zh: 在以文字为指南的图像编辑中,描述所希望的修改往往是直截了当的,但识别预期对象或区域可能很麻烦,特别是在几个对象看起来相似的情况下. 我们引入了一个新的图像编辑界面,让用户在图像上直接放置空间标记和可选短注释. 这些说明共同构成一个画布指令,指定编辑地点和修改内容. 我们的编辑器VibeEdit遵循这些指示来进行对象添加,移除,替换,属性修改,以及移动而无需单独的文本提示. 我们构建了155万个源目标编辑配对,并配有物体口罩和结构化编辑描述,我们在训练期间从中发出画布指示. 我们调整了 Quen-Image-Edit , 并配有层隔开的调制, 分别编码源图像和画布指令用于图像编辑 。 我们用区域加权监督的微调来训练这个模型,然后用文字指导的强化学习来改进编辑的完成、当地编辑的质量以及未经编辑的区域的保存。 我们评价VibeEdit以419个案例为独立构建的、经人验证的基准,强调在类似物体中选择目标。 VibeEdit的VLM路标得分79.9,外区PSNR为32.8 dB,而FireRed的路标为67.4和24.0 dB,是我们评价中最高的文本指示基准.

articles.title: Stride Independent Patching for Deep Learning
articles.content: This paper presents semi-automatic stride-independent patching (SSP) as an alternative to automatic stride-dependent patching techniques. SSP uses user or expert input to position predefined patches over one or more objects of interest. To evaluate its effectiveness, three patch-based datasets were created using SSP, overlapping patching (Overlap), and non-overlapping patching (Noverlap). DeepLabV3+ models with ResNet50, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 backbones were trained sepa-rately on each dataset. Quantitative evaluations were performed on the respective test splits and a common external test set. SSP generally achieved higher segmentation scores on the test splits and required the shortest model training time across all three backbones. On the external test set, SSP achieved the highest average precision and F1-score across backbones, whereas Noverlap achieved the highest average recall. These preliminary results demonstrate that the potentially greater spatial coverage of Noverlap and Overlap does not generally translate into better segmentation perfor-mance and that SSP offers a favorable balance between segmentation performance and model training time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 斯特里德独立 深层学习补丁
articles.content_zh: 本文提出半自动脚步独立补丁(SSP)作为自动脚步独立补丁技术的替代品. SSP使用用户或专家输入将预定义的补丁放在一个或多个感兴趣的对象上. 为了评价其有效性,利用SSP创建了三个基于补丁的数据集,重叠补丁(Overlap)和不重叠补丁(Noverlap). DeepLabV3+型号配有ResNet50,ResNet18,以及MobileNetV2主干线,在每个数据集上都接受了速成化的sepa训练. 对各自的测试分拆和共同的外部测试集进行了定量评价。 SSP在测试分数上普遍实现了更高的分数分数分数分数,并且需要所有三个骨干中最短的模型训练时间. 在外部测试集上,SSP实现了最高平均精度和F1分跨骨干,而诺韦拉普实现了最高平均召回. 这些初步结果表明,Novirap和Overlap的空间覆盖面可能扩大,但一般不会转化为更好的分化,而且SSP在分化性能和模式培训时间之间提供了有利的平衡。

articles.title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
articles.content: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Just Weather Scoring: 高效的端到端 Nowcasting 与分布式扩散
articles.content_zh: 基因传播模型非常适合概率降水即时播报,但现有方法往往依赖于经过单独训练的压缩或确定性预测组件,而且由于迭代去诺,推论成本仍然很高。 我们引入了Just Weather Scoring(JWS),这是一个单阶段,端到端的传播模型,它通过直接在雷达空间进行预测和使几步生成得以解决这两个问题. 雷达空间模型大大简化了培训和推论,并消除了因压缩损失而产生的不确定性。 JWS 组合假面同步 散射(英語:difusion),是一种保存清洁上下文同时将扩散训练适应高维时空数据的时步抽样方案,其简单的评分规则目标将训练与概率预测相配合,解锁几步生成. 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上,JWS以较低的培训和推论成本实现最新概率预测性能. 甚至我们最小的模型仍然具有竞争力,使用的参数少得多,17x以上的推论更快.

articles.title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
articles.content: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在Versal嵌入式硬件上对地球观测有效载荷数据进行在线海洋物体探测
articles.content_zh: 甚高分辨率 地球观测卫星获取的数据比存储和下行链路多,而在海上监视中,船只覆盖每个场景的一小部分。 我们研究舰载探测,作为选择下行链路的方法,根据数据的内容减少数据,而不是对每个像素进行编码;这是对常规舰载压缩的补充. 作品遵循三轴. (一) 数据和算法:从68个注解的Maxar场景生成一个有43个船级的可控数据集,并培训一个YOLOX-S探测器。 (二)嵌入式部署:探测器被量化并部署在Versal VC1902的DPU上,检测质量损失有限,每个场景的处理时间为几秒. (三) 数据减少:我们提出了几种下行链路模式,从仅元数据(box, class and rices of every survey)到船舶周围的作物图像,瓷砖持有检测,或整个背景退化的场景,以及从测量检测错误中估算出船舶所保存的每项报价与数量下行链路之间的权衡。 在我们密集的港口和海岸景点上,瓷砖保留了98%的船体,占场容的29%,农作物的83%,占3%.

articles.title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
articles.content: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 已连接的自强制: 超越视频自动递归的本地学习
articles.content_zh: 为了在保持视觉质量和时间一致性的同时流出长视频,Self Forcing通过对自制历史进行键值(KV)缓存的自我推出培训来减少曝光偏差. 为了保持内存的可控性,它解析了历史缓存,保留了块之间的前向依赖性,但切断了后向梯度路径. 我们引入了Connected Self Forcing,这是一个将梯度路径跨自动递减块重新连接起来的训练框架,可以让后期预测的反馈来指导如何产生更早期的背景. 这些连接超越了历史 KV 写法: 梯度通过生成的潜伏到生成它们的计算中,将早期上下文的生成与其在后期预测中的使用联系起来. 为使这种连接的训练内存高效,我们开发了快捷梯度重播,在不保留完整推出计算图的情况下恢复跨圆梯度. 与分布匹配的蒸馏结合,根据直属监理和对后代的贡献,连接Self Forcing列车历史块. 关于自递录视频生成的实验显示,长视线视觉质量和时间一致性都有改善,而不会改变推论程序.

articles.title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification
articles.content: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过乳腺造影喷涂进行健康反事实生成
articles.content_zh: 由于检测和治疗延迟,假阴性仍然是计算机辅助乳腺癌筛查诊断系统的一个重要限制。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了反事实数据增强策略,通过异常图像的"消除"损伤产生健康的乳房X光图,从而丰富培训分布. 我们在BI-RADS 1(健康)乳房X光图上训练一种Denoising diffusion Probabilistic模型,并使用基于RePaint的采样策略,在附加说明的损伤方块内涂抹现实的正常组织. 由此产生的健康反事实用现实的健康组织取代附加说明的损伤区域,同时保留患者特有的解剖结构,真实图像和生成图像之间的相似性测量也以此为佐证。 图像现实主义被放射学家进一步评估,发现与原始数据集质量一致. 我们评价四个有代表性的分类结构的反事实增强:一个革命神经网络(ConvNEXt)、一个视觉变压器(ViT)、一个对乳腺图-报告对(Mammo-CLIP)进行预先训练的视觉语言模型和一个基于注意力的多进取学习框架(FPN-MIL)。 在VinDr-Mammo数据集上进行的实验显示,所有结构的敏感性都有所提高,特别是在80\%固定特异性方面,有助于建立更可靠的乳腺癌CAD系统。 代码见:https://github.com/ines03garcia/difmusion-based-counterfact-generation.

articles.title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
articles.content: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LVS: 通过重用先前的视图从相对相机 Pose 中合成本地视图
articles.content_zh: 互动场景探索需要频繁的观看更新,尽管小相机运动保留了大部分可见内容. 然而,常规的3D高斯镀板使每个目标视图都变得不为所动,使得这个图像没有被利用。 重新使用已制作的图像提供了一个替代方案。 仅靠几何warping无法恢复新曝光的内容,对深度错误仍然敏感. 我们提出一个场景框架,用相对可控的RGB-D图像再利用来取代反复渲染附近视图的场景渲染. 几何warping使用深度和相对姿势来传送源内容,而轻量级的多尺度网络则预测RGB残基来修正文物并推断缺失的外观. 缓存源特性进一步减少重复计算. 关于GS-resources,剩余改进改进后PSNR改进0.72~d B 超越纯粹的扭曲;对捕捉到的场景的评价显示出低查询的空闲性。 这种将场景渲染从局部视图更新中分离出来的做法支持响应场景探索,在增强和虚拟现实中可能应用.

articles.title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
articles.content: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SuperNav: 任意场景中任何任务的代理导航系统
articles.content_zh: 通用服务机器人需要导航系统,能够在不熟悉的环境中处理人类的各种请求,将任务通用性和场景通用性结合起来. 一些现有的方法微调多式大语言模型(MLLMs),以预测导航动作,使其行为依赖于导航训练数据的覆盖范围,并有可能将通用限制在新的请求和环境. 我们的主要见解是,允许《反洗钱法》侧重于解释请求、理解场景和作出决定,同时保留其通用能力,并将运动执行权下放给导航工具。 为了实现这个想法,我们引入了SuperNav,它为预先训练的MLLM配备了专用的代理吊带,而无需对MLLM进行特定的导航微调. 我们利用导航技能、面向代理人的物理互动工具、任务进展和背景管理来支持这些决定。 一个统一的视觉点界面通过允许模型在图像中直接指定目的地,并从执行反馈中修改其决定,将决策与运动联系起来. 这些组成部分共同支持不同任务要求和环境之间的持续导航。 SuperNav在实例级别、多对象和需求驱动的任务上超越了四个评估基线。 对HM3D进行类别级评价,并在真正的四角形机器人上部署,进一步证明了其适用于各种环境。 项目网页:https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

articles.title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
articles.content: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ContourVLA:通用代号表达分片的闭环感知-行动交错政策
articles.content_zh: 通用的参考表达区划(GRES)需要动态地平衡高层次语义,以识别数量可变的语言专用表达区划,并配有精细的视觉证据,用于精确的边界划定. 这一要求挑战了现有的级联式视觉语言架构,这些架构通常依赖于静态特征界面和单通道遮罩预测,限制了适应感知和几何校正. 我们提出ContourVLA,这是一种视觉-语言行动政策,将GRES改编为封闭-loop visuomotor进程,其中可编辑轮廓作为明确的政策,它规定了对多式联运感知的条件,并由几何动作块进行更新。 Evolution-Aware语义排程(EASS) 情侣组合导线双向边界采样,具有多层次多式联运特征的状态化路由,使感知适应每个轮廓状态. 在监督初始化之后,Dustbin-Auguped Entrotic Credit Transport GRPO(DECT-GRPO)联合优化了与实例级信用相关的离散地基和连续轮廓行动. 其推出的奖励和记分来源于软预测-目标对应,这些对应说明是虚假的正值和错过的目标. ContourVLA将GIoU在最强评价基线上分别改进了8.7,2.8和2.7分,在gRefCOCO val, testA,和 testB上分别改进了GIoU,并在所有8个RefCOCOCO, RefCOCO+和 RefCOCOg 分裂中实现了最高的mIoU.

articles.title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
articles.content: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VINCIE-NExT:通过内文建模从图像解锁视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 建造一个有能力的视频编辑器仍然比视频生成器困难很多:编辑需要(来源、指示、编辑)三重设备,这些设备对注释费用过高,而且难以大规模合成,而图像编辑已经成熟,有数百万对这种设备可供使用。 在这部作品中,我们引入了VINCIE-NExT,这个统一框架通过内文本视觉演示将编辑能力从图像转移到视频,缓解了大规模配对视频编辑数据的需求. VINCIE-NExT将视频编辑分解为结构化的可堆肥子任务链(Video - > 图像 - > 图像 - > 视频,通过图像域的路由编辑意图,并在一个统一的传播目标下,使不同图像和视频公司能够进行可扩展的联合培训。 由模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑配对,被准备作为内文本视觉演示,作为每个输出框架的空间外观蓝图. 为了在互换的上下文中进行地面外观编辑,我们引入了一个新的位置编码,将图像演示和视频帧连接在一个共享的空间坐标系统中,从而能够像素真实地传播每个输出帧的外观变化. 编辑链进一步提供了原则性的测试时间缩放:通过将子任务链作为渐进传播阶段执行,可以通过投资额外计算而无需再培训来提高编辑质量. 关于OpenVE-Bench的全面实验展示了不同编辑类别的最新性能,并证实了每个组件的有效性.

articles.title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
articles.content: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 少步生成通过 数据空间迭代
articles.content_zh: 流动匹配已成为培训高质量基因模型的可扩展范例,但从所学概率流中取样需要许多网络评价。 蒸馏可以将这一成本降低到一种或几种评价;然而,一步一代往往牺牲质量,使几步一代成为实际操作制度。 现有的几步法按照概率流进行迭代计算,因此需要固定的,人工选择的时间步盘化. 这种圆盘化往往是用高压方式选择的,而且调谐费用高昂;当不同样品或空间位置的改进难度不同时,它也可能是限制性的。 我们引入了数据空间迭代,一个几步生成框架,可以完全消除流盘化. 从噪音开始,一个共享的生成器直接完善其在数据空间的预测,每个迭代都经过训练,以产生其能力允许的最佳样本. 我们的配制与配制配制蒸馏法(DMD)结合,最小变化,使得在配制的训练环境下能够对迭代方法进行有控制的比较. 在类条件ImageNet 256x256上,数据空间迭代超过了标准盘式基线,匹配或改进了通过时间表搜索选择的变体,而不需要具体的时间表培训. 这些结果表明,数据空间迭代为快速生成提供了一种简单而有效的替代圆盘化的流量空间迭代.

articles.title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
articles.content: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DVLA-RL++: 双层视野-语言与强化学习配合 少部分热学习
articles.content_zh: 少拍学习旨在从有限标签的例子中识别新颖的类别. 最近的研究纳入了文字语义,以补偿有限的视觉观察,并改善阶级表现. 然而,高成像文本协议可能既反映内在物体特性,又反映偶然的上下文,使支持原型容易受上下文污染。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出DVLA-RL++,将DVLA-RL扩展为补充语义净化(CSP)和反事实强化-学习格调(CRG). 具体来说,CSP从标签支持中生成内在和烦扰的描述,并将其协议与每个支持符进行比较. 依赖歧义的拒绝比值指导着有限的证据分配,而内在的语义锚在视觉证据不可靠时填充未指定的质量以提供倒置. CRG通过平衡识别性能和扰动接触的奖励来学习分层语义聚变的优点. 同集独立执行的参考轨迹提供了对齐的学习信号. 理论分析将保留的证据和质量与原型稳定性联系起来,并为不带偏见的政策梯度估计创造条件。 关于标准,精细,跨域基准的实验显示精度达到最新水平,平均收益比DVLA-RL高1.4%. 项目网页见https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/。

articles.title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 感知测试 2026年:挑战总结及延伸至城市规模视听理性
articles.content_zh: 继续思考 测试挑战系列,我们在瑞典马尔默举行的2026年欧洲计算机展望会议上作为讲习班组织了第四版。 本版以空间智能为主,主要播放四个不同的曲目: 统一的多选择视频 QA 和禁闭视频 QA来自最初的感知测试基准,与两条基于城市尺度步行图视频(KilometerAudio和KilometerVision)的新曲目并列. 在本报告中,我们描述了城市轨迹所使用的新基准,并总结了所有轨迹的胜负解决办法,包括一种在所有轨迹上竞争、表现令人满意的通论模式。 新增加的城市规模轨道的胜出解决方案表明,复杂的空间和多式联运推理可以通过昂贵的代理管道来解决,但对单独使用的多式联运模型来说仍然是困难的。

articles.title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
articles.content: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 整个重力领域机器人操纵中基于视觉的电动旋转最小光学-荧光表示
articles.content_zh: 基于视觉的触觉传感器提供了丰富的联系信息,但处理高分辨率图像对于像空间机器人这样的资源约束平台来说可能代价高昂. 这项工作调查了触觉运动的紧凑表现是否能够将物体在不同重力条件下旋转分类. 模拟的GelSight Mini光学流在7x9网格上聚合成126个特征,并用于对地球,火星,月球和轨道重力下负载引起的旋转方向进行分类. 引力导致这些特征发生小而显著的变化,占其差异的1.6%(R2=0.016). 尽管其规模较小,但这一转变影响到只培训过关于地球数据的模型:XGBoost精度从地球的94.4%下降到轨道的75.9%。 与此相反,在所有四个重力领域培训的单一模型总精度为96.3%,单个领域为95.1%-97.0%,而没有将重力作为投入。 表示还可以缩小为40个特性,同时保留95.7%的精确度,XGBoost每推论只需要0.14ms. 这些研究结果表明,单靠地球重力性能不足以确定空间机器人操纵的触觉感知的可转移性,这突出表明了在培训和验证过程中需要考虑到重力引起的域位转移。

articles.title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
articles.content: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LIVIN: 将空间和健全情报作为家庭数字双胞胎的基准
articles.content_zh: 现实的家庭模拟不仅必须抓住不同的环境,而且还必须抓住影响机器人运动和互动的居住物体安排和空间限制。 现有资源往往以规模、现实世界的通信以及互动准备为交换条件,在忠实、互动的复制品中留下了差距,说明真正的家园是如何实际安排的。 为此,我们引入了LIVIN,这是一个基于30个不同住家的数字双胞胎的空间和体现智能的基准。 这些复制品保留了观察到的房间布局,家具配置以及日常物品. 为了构筑它们,我们设计了由实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成和放置组成的人与人工作流程,中间结果由人类根据每个阶段的来源观测加以审查和纠正。 我们评价LIVIN的四项任务:3D探测,3D重建,导航,和loco操纵. 我们的评估表明,目前的方法仍然受到密集的物体安排、隔离、有限的自由空间以及现实生活中的有限互动区域的挑战。 我们希望LIVIN将有助于在现实生活中推进体现的AI,从空间理解到机器人互动,并最终将体现的智能带入日常的家庭环境中.

articles.title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
articles.content: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 回头看 展望:对高效多式联运的需求的视觉记忆
articles.content_zh: 从高分辨率图像处理长的视觉符号序列使得多步推理在计算上对多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)昂贵. 现有的一弹夹和聚合方法在解码前将视觉符号压缩成固定上下文. 然而,随着推理的展开,视觉证据需求可能会发生转变,使得固定的压缩上下文难以保留各阶段所需的所有细节. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出ViMoD,一个轻量级框架,它保持紧凑的视觉环境,同时随着推理需求的发展而保留对原始精细证据的获取. DART(DART)的可变聚合(DART)学习了内容适应组和聚合能力,构建了与可收回的原始精细符号相连的紧凑粗细表示. 适应性背景证据临时程序(TRACE)整合了解码历史,以预测即将到来的证据需求,并选择、保留或取代活跃的精选组。 部分精细标志会增强冷冻骨干中持续的粗糙背景,使得在不持续关注所有视觉标志的情况下能够访问特定阶段的证据。 在Qwen3-VL-4B上,ViMoD以20%的目标视觉符号预算,超越了所有8个推理基准的评价基线,使平均正常化得分比最强的评价一发基线提高39.0%. 相对于冷冻骨干而言,只有0.0546%的额外可训练参数实现了这些收益。

articles.title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
articles.content: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不要列车远行 不确定性: 早期不确定性 血管校准
articles.content_zh: 深层神经网络,包括大型语言模型,在各种任务上都取得了显著的性能. 然而,在培训或微调期间,她们容易过度自信。 在这部作品中,我们观察到不同模型的一致现象,即早期模型的校准较好,而后来的训练或微调则产生边际精度增益,但大大提高校准误差. 我们的分析表明,早期的模型在预测和特征方面都保留了不确定性意识,随着持续的培训,这种意识逐渐丧失. 为避免训练这种不确定意识,我们提议\textbf{EUA-Cal},一种将\textbf{E}作为\textbf{U}确定性\textbf{A}用于\textbf{Cal}跳动的新方法。 EUA-Cal引入了早期预测规范化,以保持早期预测不确定性和原型结构规范化,利用早期特征空间反映的不确定性,共同缓解过度自信. 关于图像分类和多选择问题回答的广泛实验涉及八个不同的模型,表明EUA-Cal优于最先进的校准方法.

articles.title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
articles.content: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DataVista:分析关于数据视频理解的多式联运LLMs
articles.content_zh: 数据视频是一种将数据可视化与视频叙事相结合的媒体形式,广泛应用于新闻报道和商业分析. 与一般的视频理解相比,数据视频理解更强调从动画图表中准确读取数据,将跨图表和时间的证据整合,以及理解叙事组织和视觉设计如何传递信息. 然而,现有的基准既针对一般录像,也针对静态图表,而数据录像了解情况尚未得到系统评价。 我们提出DataVista,这是数据视频理解的第一个基准,包含961个真实世界数据视频和6 775个评价问题,在一个三级渐进能力框架(数据感知,时间推理,叙事理解)下组织,涉及五个主题领域的10个精细问题类型. 对19个主流MLLMs的系统评价表明,表现最好的模型双子座-3.1-Pro达到70.0%的整体精度,仍然远低于人类专家的性能,模型在因果理性和叙述结构上表现最差. 增加帧数和增加字幕,主要有利于数据感知和时间推理,在叙事理解方面收益有限. 对模型反应的进一步分析确定了图读、证据判断和指令理解方面的典型故障模式。 该基准可在https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista查阅。

articles.title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FearCaut-Quen:在远景-语言模型中进行情感引导 转移危险评估决定标准
articles.content_zh: 展望语言模型(VLMs)显示出在灾害发生后进行损害评估的巨大潜力,但反复出现的一个缺陷是它们不愿意宣布危险;也就是说,即使总体准确性似乎足够,但召回率仍然很低。 本研究通过使用信号检测理论来将决策行为分解为知觉能力和决定标准放置,来检查这一缺陷. 然后,我们提出了一个纠正过度保守的决定政策的新方法,其灵感来自这样一种发现,即恐惧使人类避免了风险,并询问与恐惧有关的情感表现是否可以因果地加以操纵,以同样改变VLM的决定倾向。 利用机械解释能力,我们定位模型中一个因果牵连到的电动电路,并使用激活方向盘来操纵它,同时观察对下游预测的影响. 该方法在以Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct为基础的两阶段SeisMLM输油管上进行试验,该输油管在SeisMLM-1K试验分离上只标有27.0%的真不安全建筑,尽管证据质量足够(d'=1.521),但从未发布虚假的Red,SDT标准c=+1.354. 一个感官方向在情感丰富的自然场景上局部化,由稀释的中微子击倒和在被搁置的情感数据上分布的引导进行因果验证,然后注入建筑任务中. 恐惧定向注射将Red召回率提高到75.7%(p<0.001),减去同一方向完全抑制了Red的预测,而规范匹配的随机和匹配的幸福方向则没有显示显著效果. 这种机制是标准(c=-1.515)的转变,而歧视则没有得到改善(d'=-0.493)。 这些结果显示,VLM决定可以在不进行再培训的情况下在推论时间进行调整,并表明如何利用机械解释来诊断和控制工程应用中的VLM决定行为.

articles.title: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
articles.content: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习哪些信件可以信任:信任-加权事件-LiDAR的Camera本地化 地图
articles.content_zh: 将一个事件相机定位在预建的LiDAR映射上,可以被铸成一个已渲染的深度视图和事件图像之间的密集光学流估计,然后在诱导的3D-2D对应物上使用Purvice-n-Point(PnP)解析器. 现有管道在进行估算时依赖几何共识,但没有明确模拟个人通信的可靠性或信息性,即通信如何强烈限制相机的姿态。 我们表明,学习它的自然方法 -- -- 利用每一次的对应错误来限制信任的学习 -- -- 存在着一种依赖深度的偏差:小像素错误主要分布在大深度,不会导致高度的翔实。 相反,在我们的方法(CELL)中,我们通过姿势学习到一个每个对称的置信端到端,使用一个不同的概率的PnP,其对数分词鼓励重量配置,产生一个更好的约束姿势分布. 所学的置信有三种方式: (一)在一种脱钩的训练计划中对流控进行重新加权,使流控/尖端主干线形成梯度; (二)在测试时推动概率函证选择; (三)与网络的边缘概率一起,将最终的边缘比对精度进行加权. 我们进一步设计了部分完成深度表示,增加信号,而不产生跨越巨大差距的幻觉。 在M3ED和DSEC上,我们的完整系统比大多数评估序列的LEAR基线有所改善:它将中位翻译错误减少26.9%,中位旋转错误减少15.8%。

articles.title: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
articles.content: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 查看您可以在哪里: 启用下的 CAD 重建活动选择
articles.content_zh: CAD重建方法假设奢侈现实很少给予:不受限制的视觉访问对象,从任何理想角度拍摄. 然而,真实的物体是场景嵌入的,用螺丝钉在墙壁上,夹成圆角,在地板上休息,场景使得许多景区无法到达,其余的景点信息不均. 我们引入\textbf{SightCAD},一个参数化CAD重建的框架,将可行性视为一流的制约. 在这项工作中,我们考虑将标准CAD基准中的物体嵌入现实的室内场景中,其物理上的能见度限制在离散的视野内。 已学习的视图选择器必须选择$K$ 可行的视图,用于生成可执行的 CadQuery 代码的视觉语言模型(VLM),由已执行固件的几何忠诚度评分. 因为奖励只有在离散的视图选择,自动递归生成,以及CAD-内核执行之后才能到达,所以我们提出一个联合培训模式,其中视图选择者和CAD-生成的VLM一起接受针对这种奖励的培训. 所学的挑选政策大大偏离了随机、统一和覆盖的替代方法,在预算之间达到6.4美元跨部门联盟(IoU)点数(K\in%1,\dots,5+%美元)的优异地表面积最大化。 整个系统超越了在现场嵌入的、闭塞的多视图上的强外部基线,使DeepCAD和Fusion360物体(分别比最佳基线高出21美元和17美元)以及来自工业T-LESS基准和MP6D工业金属部分基准的合成和真实图像的试验时间域名化真实图像,同时产生任何方法中可执行程序的最高速率(有效编码率为$\leq}1.5美元)。

articles.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
articles.content: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 右屏幕, 错误的过渡: 世界模型作为 GUI 代理认证器
articles.content_zh: 一个在 Sign 上水龙头后出现的登录屏幕是预期的;在 View 命令上水龙头后的同一屏幕是攻击. 对GUI代理来说,安全因此是过渡而不是屏幕的属性,一个只检查屏幕的显示器可以通过重用合法屏幕来击败. 判断过渡需要人们期望在行动之后会有什么结果。 现有的GUI世界模型提供了一种,但是它们输出为文本,代码,或图像,因此对照被观测到的屏幕来检查需要第二种模型来判断两者. 我们主张,一个用于核查的世界模型应当在观测编码的空间中进行预测,并呈现LGWM,一种解码器无动作条件的世界模型,它直接预测下一个屏幕的表示,在1.85M真实的图形界面转换上没有语义注释训练. 核查减少为矢量比较,同一信号显示不匹配是否有害. 我们在RSWT-BENCH上进行评估,一个诊断,每个证书屏幕都出现在合法和被劫持的过渡下,因此只看到屏幕的探测器通过构造是偶然的. 无训练分数达到0.987 AUC,每决定17毫秒,与最强的闭源VLM相当,比GUI基因世界模型高出大约10个AUC点,分数在3个数量级以上的低潜度. 剩余方向达到0.953澳大利亚联合自卫军,将有害的侵权行为与良性侵权行为区分开来,而诱发的脆弱程度调查几乎是偶然的。 进一步的分析表明,这一预测是一个可以利用的未来状态,而不是一个异常的得分. 世界的模型大多是模拟器或规划器;我们的结果表明第三个作用,即核查,在代表空间的预测就是自然设计.

articles.title: Does Target Alignment Mean Target Recovery? An Evidence-Ladder Study of Adversarial Claims on Contrastive Encoders
articles.content: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 目标是否对应平均目标恢复? 关于矛盾编码器的负面索赔的证据-辅助研究
articles.content_zh: 对视觉语言模型的负面攻击优化了图像对文本目标,然后引用被攻击模型的相似性分数作为成功的证据. 我们询问,这一分数 -- -- 受害者与空间目标一致 -- -- 是否通过独立模式预测目标恢复。 我们首先建造一个测量仪器: 被攻击几何之外受监督的判官, 真实目标混合控制, 冲洗目标负数, 以及从50%的目标图像混合中得出的参考水平。 两项预先登记的研究随后比较了6个对比编码器在3个扰动预算的匹配攻击下. 训练有素的编码器(FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TradeS)比香草CLIP或SigLIP转移大量独立证据;所有8种对比都拒绝在靴子层。 然而,没有单元格达到混合产生的参考水平。 三个最好的细胞都属于它的复制带,使得实际恢复没有被确定. 在坚固的编码器中,每个样本的校正与证据增益相关(0.24-0.51美元);在香草CLIP中,相关性与零一致。 通过编码器 我们发现没有单酮对齐 -证据关系。 因此,只在一个固定的坚固编码器内提供情况,我们提供了一个报告程序。

articles.title: Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows
articles.content: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在Media-Bridged时间系列中重现身份和光谱散射 预测:将多变信号和叙述流联系起来
articles.content_zh: 媒体缩短的时间序列预测正在扩大,以包括传统的"多变"和新兴的"多式联运"(例如通过文本协助). 现有的时间序列预测模型仍然依赖于范式特异性关系,聚变,以及时间模块,阻碍了跨越数字和预配的叙事流设置的共同预测主干. 为了探索这一点,我们提议建立多媒体身份-智能棱镜网络(MIDAPN),这是一个基于媒体通用图改版和自动时间学习的统一瞬态预测主干网: (1)在媒体预调整后,我们的多媒体身份-软件图(MIDAG)通过静态本质,动态行为,以及潜在的共性,重新审视身份,诱发亲和,将不同变量的依存关系延伸至媒体. 背景身份模式(CIM)进一步完善了歧视性汇总. (2)我们开发了Spectral Prism Convolution(SPConvolution),以自动进行分级时间分析,平衡粗糙的趋势和精细的细节. 同时,其适应性搜索指南为时间分配重建配置了一个规模高效的架构. 这些脱钩但具有协同作用的组件共同解决了媒体身份分散和时间尺度不匹配的问题。 涉及16个跨13个“多变量”和12个“多模式”数据集的SOTA TSF模型的综合评价,以及有针对性的与14个时间序列基础模型的长文本比较和已融合的预先培训的语言模型,都表明MIDAPN的一贯优势和广泛共享的主干兼容性。 该代码可在\href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}获得.

articles.title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
articles.content: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Visual Information:适应性多文本引导以减缓LVLM 幻觉
articles.content_zh: 在大视野语言模型(LVLMs)中,迷幻仍然是一个重大挑战. 现有的无训练方法一般通过对比解码或视觉增强来缓解幻觉,往往会增加视觉证据在生成过程中的相对影响. 这提出了一个根本性的问题: LVLMs能动态调节不同上下文源对抑制幻觉的贡献吗? 在这项工作中,我们调查并量化LVLMs在解码过程中如何协调多个上下文源,并研究这种内在行为如何指导幻觉的缓解. 我们发现,LVLM表现出一种内在的视觉导向趋势,可以指导适应性的视觉引导,而文字背景也可以有助于缓解幻觉。 基于这些发现,我们提出AIMS(动态信息多源引导),这是一个轻量级的无培训框架,在解码过程中适应性地协调视觉,预填文本和生成的环境. 具体而言,AIMS为三个上下文域构建了紧凑的原型,并估算它们与当前查询的亲和性,以确定头部方向轴重. 由此产生的多源指导方向适用于查询表示方式,从而能够在不增加模型培训或辅助前传通行证的情况下进行适应性上下文整合。 跨越多个LVLM和解码策略的广泛实验表明,AIMS有效缓解物体幻觉,同时保持具有竞争力的通用多式联运能力.

articles.title: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
articles.content: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通用 AI- Generated 图像检测的相对补丁响应学习
articles.content_zh: 基因模型现在可以合成高度现实的图像,同时增加错误信息和视觉伪造的风险. 因此,探测人工智能生成的图像变得更加重要,可靠的探测器必须通俗化到看不见的发电机上,并保持强健到看不见的野生扰动。 现有探测器通常接受独立收集的真实图像和生成的图像的培训,或接受为减少内容偏差而设计的对齐真实生成的对子的培训。 在对齐对齐的基础上,最近的方法通过用生成的对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对等对真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真真 然而,我们发现自觉让真实和生成的补丁相互作用,因此每个补丁的特征不再单独反映自己的来源. 这种上下文的转变使得每个patch源标签是一个不精确的目标. 为此,我们提议进行相对补丁反应学习。 PRL不给每个补丁贴标签,而是在对齐对齐的两个混合视图中比较同一补丁,并从它的补丁响应中学习到其分数在视图之间的变化. (i) 为了在背景变化下进行精确的监督,相对的响应客观衡量源变化补丁的反应与源变化补丁的反应,后者仅对转移作出反应。 (二) 为提供转移的可靠参考,一个参考一致性目标使每组源不变补丁保持整体移动. (三)由于两种观点包含不同数量的生成内容,一个区域排名目标要求拥有较大生成区域的视图拥有更高的平均补丁分数. 广泛的实验表明PRL的优异性能,在8个标准基准和3个全局基准中分别以平均均衡准确度超过4.3%和5.9%的最佳前期方法。

articles.title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
articles.content: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Pose- Free Feed- Forward (无线种子) 3D 通过可学习的遮罩注意和支持涂装
articles.content_zh: 3D场景涂装旨在恢复编辑后的3D场景中缺失或渗漏的区域,同时确保几何和文字的一致性. 然而,现行做法通常需要精确校准相机的外形,这限制了其在临时、零星情况下的适用性,并增加了预处理费。 为了克服这一限制,我们提出了FreeInpaint,这个新型的FreeInforward框架,它直接从无位多视图图像和蒙蔽区域产生完整和3D一致的场景. 作为其核心,FreeInpaint扩展了一个3D基础模型,从参考视角向其他无位视图传播蒙面区域,连接3D重建与场景涂装,同时保留模型本土恢复相机姿势和场景几何能力. 我们的方法处理两个关键挑战,即如何调整向导3D基础模型以掩盖投入。 首先,蒙蔽区域可能腐蚀交叉视图的函证推理,贬低姿势估计和几何恢复. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一个可学习的蒙面关注机制,该机制保持可靠观测的空间定位,同时允许蒙面区域逐步吸收更深层的有用背景。 第二,在严重隔离下,一次前行通行证往往缺乏充分外表证据,无法完成高度的忠诚。 因此,我们提出 " 支持Token精准化战略 " ,该战略将扩散产生的支持证据作为信心加权辅助标志,在保持原有空间锚地的同时,完善观测不足的区域。 跨多种数据集的广泛实验表明,FreeInpaint在保持快速推论速度的同时,实现了优异的涂装质量,消除了对预计算相机的依赖. 项目网页为https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.

articles.title: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
articles.content: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VEDJE:可缩放视频-文本检索视频-有效歧视联合编码器
articles.content_zh: 寻找正确的视频往往需要区分发生不同事件的类似场景. 联合匹配可以改善检索,但处理每个查询的丰富的视频表述费用高昂. VEDJE在采样框内压缩特征,同时将其表达式在可重复使用的缓存中分开. 特性变化预测提供辅助训练信号,改进从压缩缓存的检索,而不在查询时添加工作. 在MSR-VTT,MSVD,DiDeMo,以及ActiveNet上,VEDJE在两个检索方向上改进了匹配的第一阶段检索器R@1. 在MSR-VTT上,它以微调的VideoCLIP-XL第一阶段达到59.8文本对视频R@1. 在 VideoPrism 配置中,将 per-video 缓存缩写为 4 倍到 12 KiB 保留 0.2 点之内的文本到视频召回. 这些结果显示,准确的视频搜索可以在紧凑的证据上操作,一次编码,随着新查询的到来再使用.

articles.title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
articles.content: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过复杂 Valued Fusion 本地化的开放式词汇视听事件
articles.content_zh: 开放式词汇视听事件本地化(OV-AVEL)给每个视频段贴上活动课的标签,包括训练期间从未见过的课. 主流管道使用冷冻的多式联运基模型(如ImageBind)将视觉框架,音频mel-spectrogram,以及每个候选类名嵌入一个共享空间,然后计算每个段对每个类的两个余弦相似:视觉文本和音频文本. 现有方法再将这对子折叠成一个具有固定规则(几何平均值,加权平均值)的单倍分数,然后再取矩形. 相反,我们计算复杂价值的相似性,并利用复杂价值的神经网络(CVNN)来学习它们的聚变. 每种模式的标准表述 成为我们管道中真正的部分, 和一对伴流 供应想象的部分。 我们使用想象中的iHSV部分用于视觉模式,而CycleGAN-翻译的相位光谱用于音频模式作为这些伴奏流. 这造成了两个复杂的相似之处,然后相互融合。 虽然视觉和音频编码器仍然被冷冻,但只有时间注意区块和聚变CVNN得到训练. 四流复合建筑在OV-AVEL两个基准上设定了一个新的艺术状态. 在OV-AVE Bench的开放式(不明级)拆分上,我们达到66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1(比先前报告的微调基线多出1.6/+4.1/+6.6),对所见类别也有一致的收益。 我们还为这项任务修改了AVE数据集,并观察到我们的架构已经达到 60.7/519/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1,实现最先进的OV-AVEL结果。 我们还提出了一个双流替代方案,它也比基线大有改进。

articles.title: From Suppression to Repair: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Localized Distribution Alignment
articles.content: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从压制到修复:通过本地化分配对齐,减轻大视野-语言模型中的物体幻觉
articles.content_zh: 对象幻觉仍然是大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)产生可靠内容的主要障碍. 一种直观的缓解策略是在隐藏的表示中抑制与幻觉相关的成分. 然而,这些组成部分也可能包含有用的信息,加以压制可能会削弱模型的多式联运能力。 在本文中,我们提出ResOT,这是一种无培训方法,通过局部分布调整来修复推断时的表述. 具体来说,ResOT项目将主力幻觉方向从忠实的子空间向外,形成一个低维的剩余子空间进行干预. 在这个子空间内,ResOT使用高斯最佳传输(OT)使幻觉的分布与忠实者一致. 由此形成的地图定义了修复目标,对原始表述的修改最小. 推断,ResOT适应性地控制着每个象征状态向OT目标移动的程度. 对三个具有代表性的LVLMs的实验表明,ResOT可以大大减少物体的幻觉,同时改善图像标题的质量和跨多个基准的多式联运性能。 代码将被发布。

articles.title: From Pixels to Structure: Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Document OCR and Structured JSON Extraction
articles.content: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从像素到结构:文档OCR和结构化JSON提取的轻量级视野-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 虽然大规模、闭源的Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)为文件理解设定了强有力的基准,但由于数据自主性、经常性成本以及超规模计算的环境足迹,对商业API的依赖限制了机构档案中的采用。 这在遗产数字化中尤为尖锐,文件包括历史笔迹,特定域名词(如珠宝,史前,建筑),以及需要高维结构提取的非标准布局. 我们提出一个比较研究,对三个大学遗产收藏的8个光学字符识别(OCR)到结构的开源轻量级VLM(最多7B参数)进行比较研究。 鉴于文件图像,模型必须提取文本并生成符合计划的JSON,从而能够自动验证和下游使用。 我们利用字符误差率(CER),近似常态化Levenstein相似性(ANLS*),以及平均精度F1(mAP-F1),在0射、数射和微调设置下,对限制-意识协议下的模型进行评估,测量提取忠性和结构输出质量。 根据微调基线,我们进一步测试(一) 超参数优化、(二) 古典图像预处理(照明平整、去诺定和CLAHE)和(三) 多阶段培训的独立影响。 最后,我们分析了数据集特定微调与单一多数据集检查站之间的权衡,在这两个检查站,联合培训使一个模型能够跨收集系统运行,但能够在数据集之间转变性能。 总的来说,我们显示,经过仔细调整的具有最多7B参数的VLM可以提供一种可持续的,私人的,高性能的替代人工抄录或商业黑盒系统,我们为寻求机构控制的OCR到JSON提取的遗产机构提供可操作的指导.

articles.title: Fast Pose Tracking of Rigid Objects with Compact Pose Graph Optimization
articles.content: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 快速Pose 跟踪硬质物体并优化压缩Pose图
articles.content_zh: 追踪一个小物体的6D在长视野上的姿势,目前需要的是昂贵的登船或者在整个序列中保持重建. 这使得目前的追踪器对机器人操纵和增强现实不切实际,这需要随时可以使用和运行的追踪器. 我们显示,轻量级跟踪模块可以应用在广泛的函证估计方法之上,在保持快速运行时间的同时保持漂移的界限. 我们的关键想法是避免在姿势图中基于点的优化,而只在相对的姿势限制上运行,我们用几何对齐所产生的不确定性来权衡这些限制. 这使得优化与函数独立,同时避免直接包含噪点测量,从而导致快速而有力的长期跟踪. 在四种现实世界基准中,我们的方法实现了追踪准确性,与基于重建的追踪器相当,其优化成本只有一小部分。 总的来说,这些结果表明,一个紧凑和可靠的图型优化可以提供长距离的一致性,同时大大降低计算成本。

articles.title: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
articles.content: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.
articles.subject: paper
