articles.title_zh: 多维空间理解的搜索和录像
articles.content_zh: 现有多视图空间推理方法主要以稀疏的投入观点运作。 因此,视觉语言模型(VLMs)被限制在这些固定视图中理解一个场景并推断空间关系,从而导致脆弱的交叉视图对接和几何对语言瓶颈. 为了解决这些问题,我们制定了一部小说《探索与观察》推理法,通过定位与问题有关的观点来寻找隐含的交叉视野空间证据,以支持空间推理。 为了实现这个方法,我们提议万塔奇(Vantage),一个没有训练的模型-不可知推理框架,将VLM与3D基础模型配对:一个基于观点的推理阶段,用于问题分析和观点规划,然后是几何基础的证据增强阶段,以有效综合视觉证据,并将其纳入最终推理. 6个甚高频综合试验显示,在5个基准上不断改进,但没有微调。 总体而言,通过基于视图的推理揭示空间证据,万塔奇可以在很大程度上减少对基于语言的交叉视图对齐的依赖,提高多视图空间理解. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage上查阅。

articles.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
articles.content: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Memento 3: 通过反射规则书进行模型式递归自我改进
articles.content_zh: 学会在陌生的环境中行动,需要代理人推断世界是如何运作的,并随着新证据的到来修改这种理解. 然而有限的观测可以支持多种世界模型,这些模型可以解释过去的相互作用,但预测在看不见的状态下的不同结果. 我们以Memento系列为基础,引入Memento 3,使冷冻的LLM剂能够通过外部记忆不断学习清晰的世界模型. 该剂维持一个自然语言的规则书作为持久的语义记忆,记录关于环境动力学的可修改的假设,同时留下未知的方面不够精确. 它将这个规则书汇编成可执行代码,用于预测和规划. 通过不断循环的观察,反射,规则修订,编译和核查,代理商使用预测错误来完善规则书及其代码. 更新的代码只有在LLM判断它忠实于规则书时被接受,并且细胞精确重播复制所观察到的过渡. 我们将此过程作为递归自我改进(RSI)的基于模型的路径来调查: 代理人自主探索环境,修改其世界模型,并使用经过核实的更新来指导后续的相互作用和学习,而基础LLM仍然固定. 人口扩展维持多个平行的世界模型,共享互动证据,并利用其预测指导探索. 在ARC-AGI-3上,单型代理清理了所有25个公共游戏的每个关卡,实现了100.0的平均相对人类动作效率(RHAE),并使用了人类动作计数的44%. 在一个Atari Pong的案例研究中,一个学习的反馈控制器在三个评价的片段中每集胜21:0,开局不同,不再使用LLM调用.

articles.title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
articles.content: Generating physically plausible videos for solid-gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG, a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid-gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phasespecific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid-gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以物理为基础的动态和相互作用的相感视频生成
articles.content_zh: 为固体气体动力学制作物理上可行的视频具有挑战性,因为不同阶段表现出不同的动力学,但通过物理相互作用仍保持结合。 我们介绍PAVG,一个用于固体气体动力学和相互作用的PAVG,即一个PAVG,即PAVG,即PAVG. 它使用双分支结构,明确模拟固体和气体的显著动态,同时瞬间交叉心动捕捉它们的物理相互作用. 这种设计使PAVG能够保持相位特定运动特性,同时产生跨阶段物理上一致的响应. 为了便利这项工作,我们进一步构建了一个模拟装置,由700多千个物理轨迹组成,涵盖各种固体、气体和固体气体相互作用的情况。 广泛的评价表明,与现有方法相比,我们的PAVG制作的视频具有更高的运动坚持度、物理可信度和视觉质量。

articles.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
articles.content: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Skill-V:可验证的交互式代理自演技能库
articles.content_zh: 互动代理人可以将经验转化为可重复使用的技能,但现有的自我发展技能库主要通过积累新知识而得到改善。 失败可能导致新的技能,而随着新证据的到来,以前储存的技能较少得到重新审视。 然而,仅凭增长并不能确保可靠性,因为在当前的任务条件下,检索到的技能可能不适用,而现有的技能可能编码错误指定的业务边界。 因此,可靠的技能演变不仅需要增加知识,还需要测试和修订已经储存的东西。 我们介绍Skill-V,一个可核查的自我发展技能库. 为了让存储的知识可以测试,我们提出代表技能作为版本的,可伪造的合同,将语义意图与可观察到的行为标准联系起来. 我们利用环境结果推动图书馆的发展。 具体来说,任务失败促使技能增加,而合同评价和任务成果之间的分歧则指导对现有技能界限的修订。 为了证实这些修订,我们要求它们保持受保护的语义限制,并满足历史重播证据上标点结果的不倒退标准。 最后,我们使用一种可适用性感知过滤器来排除被怀疑不适用于当前任务的候选人。 在整个ALFWorld和WebShop,Skill-V分别实现了95.3%和85.9%的成功率,同时保持了比面向增长的基线更紧凑的技能库. 适用性过滤减少了对技能的不正确引用,基于结果的修订在不贬低以往观察到的证据的性能的情况下纠正了特定技能界限。 这些结果表明,可靠的技能演变不仅需要积累经验:图书馆必须学会保留哪些知识,何时修订,何时应用。

articles.title: From Video Clips to Creation Trajectory: Sora100K for AI-Native Video Creation
articles.content: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从视频剪辑到创建轨迹:用于AI-Native视频创建的 Sora100K
articles.content_zh: AI-Native视频创作正从孤立的视频剪辑转向迭代视频创作工作流程. 但是,现有的数据集基本上仍然是视频剪辑,代表视频生成和编辑是视频创建工作流程中单独的任务,而不是连接的阶段. 在本文中,我们引入了Sora100K,一个代表AI-Native视频创作工作流程的数据集,作为结构化视频创作轨迹. 具体而言,我们首先确定视频创作轨迹,并根据其结构作用将其分解为三个子集:文本到视频生成记录为根,单回合视频编辑记录为编辑边缘,多回合视频编辑记录为完整轨迹. 然后,我们用一个VLM来分配生成根的语义说明和编辑边缘的编辑操作说明. 严格的施工管道在确保数据质量的同时,进一步重建了源到编辑线条,编辑顺序和中间视频状态. 最后,我们对LTX-2型号进行轻量级改造,以评估Sora100K的监理价值. 结果显示视觉质量、多镜头生成和交叉镜头一致性都有所改善,而连续的回合评价显示,遵循多回合编辑指示仍然具有挑战性。 Sora100K为AI-Native视频的创作建立了新的数据基础,超越了孤立的视频片段,走向结构化的视频创作轨迹. 数据集和补充材料可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K上公开查阅。

articles.title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
articles.content: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内存强制 : 流传视频世代的可视中视历史
articles.content_zh: 自动递归式视频的传播使得因果视频流没有双向通过整个剪辑,但现有的几步系统通常只在固定大小的KV缓存中保留开口和最近的帧. 一旦一个事件离开这个窗口, 后期的帧就不能再关注它了, 一个失败,我们称之为中视线遗忘。 我们提出记忆强化,一种几步串流的方法,在不增加缓存大小的情况下保存这个缺失的历史. 它的 Archive QQ Work Banks 将缓存分割为沉淀区, 归档区和工作区, 由于绝对时间指数漂移在培训范围之外,银行意识到的RoPE在注意时重新分配指数,因此每个银行仍然可以区分。 在1.3B时,记忆强化引领更长的剪辑,在报告所有四个长度的方法中显示最小的从5s下降到60s,并通过休假和回归来保存主题和场景. 同样的设计尺度为Wan2.2 5B, 制作更符合实际、更现实、更动态的视频,

articles.title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
articles.content: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dino 强制流动模型 : 不要暴露你所能预测的
articles.content_zh: DINO等共同识别预加训练的表示方式可以大幅度提高流量匹配模型的训练速度和质量,但它引入了第二个调试轨迹,需要精心设计的时间表. 我们提出一个更简单的方案:直接预测预先训练过的表示,然后以自己的预测作为模型的条件。 这样就不再需要第二个业务守则和任何针对代表的取消提名时间表,同时保留代表指导的好处。 我们的做法大大加快了速度,实现了以FID分数衡量的更好的发电质量。 在ImageNet上,它比先前的方法少2x的时空比潜在空间的艺术状态要好;在像素空间中,它比可比的先前方法改进了超过20%的FID. 这些结果支持一个简单的原则:不要欺骗你所能预测的东西。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing上公开查阅。

articles.title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
articles.content: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FastBench: Can 流式 VLMs 透视高动态 真实世界流?
articles.content_zh: 流式视频大语言模型(VLMs)使得视频能够持续理解,然而现有的基准侧重于低动态情景. 在限定的上下文预算下,模型必须平衡时间历史、空间分辨率和时间颗粒性;1-2-FPS的零星采样错过了快速事件。 我们介绍Fast Bench来评估现实世界视频流中高动力感知. 它的轨迹定位管道结合了高FPS剪辑的QA生成,在2 FPS过滤问题答案,使用SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹进行解答验证,以及三轮人类检查. Fast Bench包含跨8个域的306个QA对,6个容量,以及前,即时,落后的时间范围,并带有人附加说明的证据间隔. 我们还提出 " 主动Frame " ,这是一个无培训基线,通过文本符号调整收到的帧率。 双层滑动窗口保留了最近的高FPS观测数据,同时将较老的观测数据降为稀疏的历史。 实验揭示了实质性的局限性:最强的模型双子座3.5-Flash,得分只有50.7%. Denser采样改进了Qwen3-VL-8B,从2 FPS的32.9%提高到24 FPS的44.6%,但随着历史的压缩而增饱和. 主动 框架比稀有的统一取样多5.4和1.5个百分点,但仍远远低于oracle指导重点,表明当需要更精确的时间感知时,目前的VLM就难以从溪流中确定。 Fast Bench为高动力流视频理解提供了测试台. 代码和数据:https://github.com/Ashone3/Fast Bench.

articles.title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WOVEN:将视觉世界模型制作成多式联运有限责任公司
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)与空间,内涵,物理,时间推理发生斗争. 我们假设,这些失败反映了视觉过渡推理方面的共同缺陷,并测试这种能力是否能够作为一个共同的训练原始,一种不同的模型可以从不同的监督来源中学习,并跨不同的任务重复使用,并有系统的培训配方. 现有基准分别记录这些缺陷,但并不支持在场景、行动和推理业务中进行有控制的比较。 因此,我们引入了WOVEN,一个视觉过渡推理的培训来源和基准,通过场景,动作和推理类型来组织过渡监督,使用不同,现实的从视频预修的基因模型展开:共有36,076个实例,涉及20种场景类型,5种动作类型,8种推理类型. 我们首先评价了38种前沿的MLLM(例如GPT-5.4和Qune3-VL-235B-A22B),并发现了一个实质性的系统性的缺陷:即使是最强的模型也远远低于人类,失败在模范家庭之间反复出现,并且以规模持续. 然后,我们在WOVEN上进行多种规模的MLLMs培训,发现它们学会了一种共享的能力,可以广泛转让:培训的子集,每个子集只有大约2 000件,使26个外部基准中的22个提高了27.3个百分点,WOVEN数据可以以可比较的准确性取代任务本身培训数据的30-50%。 控制下的比较进一步为视觉世界的建模提供了培训配方,在被搁置的基准上预先验证:通过它所教的推理操作选择监督,而不是通过它显示的行动、场景或领域选择监督,更倾向于对视觉状态进行更大的改变,以保持稳健。 我们的工作将视觉过渡推理确定为在MLLMs系统化的视觉世界模型培训的可重复使用的基础。

articles.title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
articles.content: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预测与价值说明的通用一致
articles.content_zh: LLM开发者在后培训他们的模型,以展示亲社会价值和行为特征,这些在对齐目标中被列出. 然而,虽然最近的培训后发展产生了在调整评价上得分很高的模型,但有关几套狭义行为的培训模型仍然以出人意料的方式影响着他们跨越看不见的环境的行为。 在本文中,我们确立了对齐一般化预测的任务,即预测一个模型如何微调一个遵循特定值的模型如何改变其跨越一系列被搁置值的行为. 我们对现代配对指标中发现的66个值的配对通用效应进行了大规模分析,并对配对通用预测任务进行了基准代表技术分析。 我们发现,在上下文应用值时,基于模型激活的表示方式大大超过了基于对值的文字描述的方法。 具体而言,以激活为基础的最佳方法与我们的概括矩阵的关联性为0.45,而以描述为基础的基线为0.05。 然后,我们通过利用各种表述来衡量多值配对目标中的数值的相似程度,从而表明预测对下游任务的配比一般化的表述的适用性,我们发现这些表述与模型稳健性密切相关。 最后,我们展示了一个共享的,模型独立的价值空间的初步证据,我们用这个空间来开发基于经验性概括动态的LLM值的第一个分类学. 我们的工作表明,研究有限责任公司的价值概括及其应用对模型行为经验性更强的设计和培训十分重要。

articles.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
articles.content: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ViSkill:增强VLM代理,增强视觉-自然技能
articles.content_zh: 技能强化剂通过将成功的轨迹蒸馏成可重复使用的策略,提高样本效率. 然而,大多数现有方法仍然以文字为中心,将空间布局和动作状态对应线化,变成失去几何结构的语言。 最近的努力已开始纳入视觉证据,但将技能建设和更新与政策优化分开,使相互改进的情况没有得到充分利用。 我们提出ViSkill,这是一个视觉-内在技能学习框架,将成功的交互编码为VLM代理直接访问的复合视觉技能卡. 获取的技能指导推论和奖励塑造,而成功的轨迹则被提炼回图书馆,形成闭塞的反馈循环,其中技能积累和政策改进相互加强. 可选的冷启动机制进一步加快了早期学习. 通过对Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill的评价,ViSkill取得了0.89的总体成功率,通过冷启动初始化,上升至0.91,比所有评估的专有和开源基线都好,同时比标准的PPO更快聚合。 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill上找到.

articles.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpaceCast-Bench:评价远景-语言模型中的预测空间理由
articles.content_zh: 现有空间推理基准主要测试空间感知:读取输入中已经可见的关系. 然而,现实世界的空间智能需要预测空间推理:从观测中构建一个场景,预测干预如何改变它,以及对看不见的结果进行推理. 我们介绍了SpaceCast-Bench,这是直接和诊断性地评估这种能力的第一个基准。 围绕一个观测-变形法框架,182个真实世界场景的3862个问题涉及16个任务类型,分三个层面:静态感知、局部预测和全球预测,逐步需要场景理解、空间状态更新以及对未观测结果的关联推论。 评估21种模型暴露出一个明显的差距:最强模型只达到58.0%,而人类的性能为87.2%,而空间专用模型仍然接近随机机会. 受控制的分析进一步表明,桥梁观点对综合分布式观测至关重要,明确的立体证据模型比生成的结果图像或视频更可靠。 微调我们方案生成的数据,将Qune3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%,在六个领域外基准中实现宏观平均收益。

articles.title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
articles.content: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过可执行程序搜索 LLM- Guided Blockwise 特性工程
articles.content_zh: 工业风险控制系统通常依靠结构化数据模型进行高效预测,但大量有价值的信息仍嵌入无结构的长文本中。 通过人工特性工程提取这种信息是劳动密集型的,同时要求大型语言模型(LLM)处理每一个实时输入可能无法满足实际部署要求. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议LLM-BlockFE,这是一个LLM制导的离线功能构建框架,将长文本转换为可执行的功能程序,从而避免在线推论期间LLM调用. LLM-BlockFE通过递增附加不可变的代码块构建特征程序,并使用下游模型评价候选特征. 为了解决传统贪婪的搜索被困在不理想解决方案中的倾向,我们的方法引入了基于深度校准信用分配的区块级回滚机制,并以互离方式推进多个独立搜索轨迹,通过共享每个轨道探索方向的固定描述来减少冗余探索. 搜索后,产生的程序被冻结并部署,为下游预测模型提取结构化特征. 在两个公共数据集和两个私人数据集中,LLM-BlockFE在全数据集比较中,每个数据集最强基线的绝对AUC改进率为0.0069至0.0358。 对5个已部署的财务风险控制应用程序的发射后监测显示,KS比现有人工设计的战略有0.02至1.56个百分点的绝对改进。

articles.title: Latent Core Tokenizer: Compress, but Meaningfully
articles.content: Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 缓冲核心切除器:压缩,但意义深远
articles.content_zh: 托肯化器通常被优化以进行压缩,但紧凑的词汇不一定在语言间平均分配其容量. 我们介绍Latent Core Tokenizer(LCT),一种将结构发现与词汇构造区分开来的语言不可知论方法. LCT在构建一个共享词汇之前,使用最小描述长度,基于 en的边界信号,以及形态约束来识别可重复使用的语言单元. 在104种语言中,有200K-token词汇,LCT实现了比BPE,Unigram,以及平等意识的BPE更低的生育力和更高的morphScore,同时在象征性化成本方面保持了可比的跨语言差异. 在四个多语种下游基准中,LCT的总分分别比BPE,Unigram和对等的BPE提高1.48分,1.83分和2.00分. 我们的研究结果表明,光是压缩并不能预测表达质量,并突出了形态学驱动的结构发现的重要性,以及如何利用频率在语言之间分配最终词汇.

articles.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
articles.content: Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OnTrack:通过流式结构-智能优化运输对LLM代理轨迹进行实时监测和干预
articles.content_zh: 特务部署在从旅行规划员和股票交易到信息技术事件分类的应用程序中。 在大多数情况下,LLM代理人在最低限度的基于规则的保障下自主工作,导致不可逆行动带来的成本和安全问题。 近期的作品解决了这个问题,要么使用保障剂来监测行为,要么评价浩克后日志. 第一种会给每一步增加成本和耐久性;第二种会在跑完之后,当象征性物被烧毁,损坏完成时做出判决. 为了克服这种情况,我们提议OnTrack,一种流动监测机制,将代理的步态和依赖性与记录的成功运行相比较,以提醒用户或每步约一毫秒的阻断代理. 我们在三种减少访问的制度中研究这个问题:完全参考访问(历史运行和工具计划),中间访问(只有工具计划),以及没有先前的知识(仅生成步骤日志). 对OnTrack的监测能力的期待随着数据访问的减少而减少,从计划违规检测到识别环路,摊位,以及重复的工具呼叫. 最后,我们利用SWE-bench轨迹评估OnTrack. 根据前8个步骤,我们的方法将不及格的轨迹排在后续轨迹以下,优于内容相似性方法(+0.057 AUROC)。 使用流产政策,我们节省了大约18%的计算结果,这些计算结果会在故障运行时被烧毁,83%的中断运行实际上会走向失败(6次流产中有5次是正确的)。

articles.title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
articles.content: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 哪个技能去迪斯蒂尔? SGUID: 选择一个模型技能共同演变的契约技能库
articles.content_zh: 技能,在推论中添加的可重复使用的程序指导,可以大大改善LLM下游的性能(Li等人,2026年)。 先前的工作通过语义相关性从银行中回收技能,然后将其作为推论时间补丁或用于模型蒸馏. 然而,每种技能的个人效用基本上被忽视。 我们首先表明,在以技能为条件的政策作为教师的政策提炼中,不到25%的回收技能提供了有用的提炼信号。 然后我们提出SGUID,一种选择精密技能子集用于蒸馏的方法. 只有在培训期间持续产生有效的学习信号时,SGUID才保留一种技能。 然后对选定的技能进行提炼,以产生更好的模型。 我们的结果显示,并非所有技能都值得提炼。 在奥尔莫和奎恩家族的4个模型中,在4个模型中的3个模型上,以平均值avg@12的形式,对6个选定的技能进行蒸馏或超过全银行蒸馏,在对3个新选定的技能进行蒸馏的第二轮之后,对所有4个模型进行蒸馏,而全银行的蒸馏量则高达11x大。 重要的是,SGUID支持稳定的模型技能共演:经过一轮蒸馏后,从更新模型的推出中将一个新的候选银行进行管理,SGUID选择哪些技能可以内化下一步. 在第二轮中,这个循环选择了3个新技能,并将Qune3-8B从64.3%提升到66.3%. 选择步骤对于稳定性至关重要:在Quen3-4B上,天真地更新未过滤技能的模型会降低性能,包括在HMMT25上降0.3个百分点,而SGUID则在第一轮后将HMT25提高0.5个百分点,在第二轮后提高1.1个百分点. 这些结果将技能选择确定为稳定模式技能共同演变的关键机制。

articles.title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
articles.content: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 援引但未协商:对法律信仰链的反事实审计
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模式越来越多地为法律决定提供理由,将判决背后的法规或先例点名,作为判决所依据的证据。 我们直接测试一下: 将案件事实固定下来, 我们用指定的法律权威 来代替一个无关的权威, 并解码一个模型不断演变的判决 从隐藏状态。 在7个开放量级模型(8B-70B)和4个涵盖司法和合同推理的基准中,当明确要求通过命名治理当局来证明判决的合理性时,模型在66.7%-100%的几代人中指定正确者为正确者,而当当局发生变化时,判决的改变则远非一致:案例HOLD为0.0-21.7 %,ECHR和SCOTUS为30.0%-76.7%,合同NLI为43.3%-50.0 %。 无论是规模还是目的所建立的法律理由模型(最优劳拉复制;第6节)都无法弥补这一差距。 对5个核心模型的红色团队评价发现,在案件事实中隐藏的对抗性指令(73.3%-96.4%)的遵守率大大超过了判断-冲洗敏感性,在模型排名中毫无例外地维持不变。 因此,指定一个法律权威机构是判决依赖它的不良代名词,而同一判决却仍然容易受到对抗性操纵。 这两项调查结果都通过检查加以复制,排除了迅速措辞的噪音和无稽之谈的取样,并直接影响到使用所产生的法律解释作为合规或审计工具。

articles.title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
articles.content: When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 准确但并非Humble:在知识冲突下评估LLM代理中的隐蔽性
articles.content_zh: 当检索到的证据与代理人的先前信念相矛盾时,它是否修改答案,承认不确定性,还是坚持作出错误的结论? 对代理系统的现有评价主要侧重于任务的成功,对代理机构如何处理这种冲突提供了有限的见解。 我们提议评价代理人在感知谦卑(EH):代理人在执行任务时是否愿意承认、采取行动和通报不确定性。 我们通过三个轨迹层面的行为维度:识别、解决和Escalate(ISE)。 通过知识冲突,当主干语言模型的参数化知识与它遇到的证据相矛盾时,或两个背景来源有分歧时,我们评价两个冲突环境:(1) 控制的冲突和(2) 多步骤代理执行期间自然发生的冲突,每种情况都有对应的无冲突控制。 在评价四个代理人时,我们发现更高的任务精确度不一定对应更大的直觉谦卑:一些高精确度的配置承认执行过程中的冲突,但并不传达其错误的最终答案中尚未解决的不确定性. 轨迹层面的分析进一步揭示,特工经常在早期执行步骤中发现冲突,但未能在后期步骤中保持或解决冲突. 最后,我们显示,模型层面的干预可以改善EH,但往往以任务准确性为代价,这表明骨干模型、代理人利用和评价环境之间的相互作用产生了感官谦卑。

articles.title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
articles.content: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 克服前期障碍:在长图发行下监督精细化
articles.content_zh: 监督的微调(SFT)将预先训练的大型语言模型(LLMs)适应下游任务,但所需的概念可以得到不同程度的预先训练的支持. 经常使用的概念更有可能得到很好的学习,而很少使用的概念可能仍然很少。 我们引入了一个名为前障碍的新概念,以量化预先训练的模型在多大程度上支持与目标概念相竞争的概念。 我们注意到,先前的障碍遵循长尾分布,将头和尾的概念置于SFT的不同起点:头的概念面临较低的前障碍,而尾的概念则需要额外的指示来克服其较高的前障碍. 我们的理论分析还得出了SFT在长尾之前的屏障下受到的预测风险,明确描述先前的屏障和累积的SFT证据如何共同决定预测性能. 基于这一先前的依赖障碍的需求,我们提议采用适应性的SFT教学选择方法,构建参考概念,估计每项教学提供的区别证据,并适应性地将选择预算分配给目前选择中仍没有充分涵盖的概念。 这样,PASS共同考虑哪些指示可以提供有用的证据,哪些指示需要在有限的预算下提供额外的监督。 实验显示,我们的方法在四个主干预算设置上一贯优于七种最先进的教学选择方法. 一项减税研究进一步表明,PASS的适应性分配比统一分配不断改善.

articles.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
articles.content: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AI特工们能学着如何登顶吗? 在长跑游戏代理游戏比赛中评价热力学习
articles.content_zh: 逆境游戏推动了从欣欣向荣的搜索到强化学习的进步,然而从有限的样本中学习和调整策略仍然具有挑战性. AI代理商通过将游戏体验转化为可执行政策的修改,提供了另一种选择. 在Heuristic学习(HL)的基础上,我们将Aversarial Heuristic学习(AHL)正式化,这个范式使用AI代理作为学习引擎来完善游戏政策和支持软件,同时保持模型权重固定. 我们介绍了AAArena, 由12个真实的对抗游戏和1,920个存档的人类程序组成的基准, 其评价协议模式为真实世界的游戏竞赛. 代理解释规则,选择对手,分析回放,并修改游戏代理,使其在固定匹配和评价预算内达到最高排名. 我们评价\val{完成的模型}模型和操纵配置:与Claude Code合作的Opus5.5获得6枚金牌,而没有经过评价的配置在其余6枚人类梯子上方. 在规则规格较为复杂的游戏中,性能一般较弱. 进一步的实验表明,对手的挑选和密集的反馈支持政策改进,代理商从政策上的重玩中学习到自己的配对以及政策外的重玩其他玩家的配对. 这些结果凸显了HL在对抗游戏中的潜力,并找出了游戏理解,战略实施,以及长视政策制定方面的持续挑战.

articles.title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
articles.content: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VFold: 对称- 软件十字架 值缓存压缩
articles.content_zh: 虽然缓存键值(KV)状态可以加速大语言模型(LLM)解码,但这种缓存可以在长上下文长度时主导内存使用. 一个解决方案是通过利用层间缓存的相似性来压缩这个内存. 然而,大多数现有技术都要求对法学硕士课程进行建筑修改,并需要大量间接费用。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个对称的——认识值缓存合并策略,减少缓存内存,同时避免在解码过程中有害的性能退化和建筑管理费用. 此外,我们表明,可以利用现有缓存压缩技术来利用这种方法,同时采用高比例量化或密钥缓存推算法,达到两种方法都无法单独达到的压缩比率,而增加的费用最低。 归根结底,我们的调查结果揭示了价值缓存能力利用不足的一个主要来源,为在内存限制下缩小上下文窗口提供了简单而有效的方向。

articles.title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
articles.content: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Sparse 解码: 精确高效 LLM 的解码- Aware Pruning 推论
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)推论的解码阶段的内存约束性质产生了很大的延迟. 由黑森人指导的无层训练网络穿梭方法一直是这个问题的突出解决方案,因为穿梭会减少解码时从内存读取的非零参数的数量. 尽管如此,这行的典型方法还是使用预先收集的自然序列来计算黑森人,而模型在解码时被喂食自我生成的令牌,在两个序列之间产生分布偏移. 在自然序列上计算出的黑森语不同于在生成序列上计算出的. 我们观察到,这种差异导致在生成过程中激活的分布偏离了用于挤压的分布,进一步伤害了挤压的模型性能. 此外,大多数现有的LLM推算方法带来了实际的加速,主要针对稀疏的矩阵-矩阵(SpMM)乘法,为占解码主力的稀疏矩阵-载体(SpMV)操作提供了有限的支持. 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了SparseDecoding,这是为准确高效的LLM解码而专门设计的原则性解码-意识解码框架. 具体地说,在算法轴上,SparseDecoding从密集模型自递归生成过程中收集的层层激活中构建校准矩阵,不包括预填,从而将普鲁因目标与解码激活对齐. 在系统轴上,我们开发了一个最优化的N:M稀疏矩阵-向量内核,配有比特mask索引和固定步骤的转录. 具有代表性的LLMs(Llama-3.1-8B,Llama-3.3-70B,Quen3-14B / 32B)上的实质性经验结果表明,我们的方法一贯优于长式生成基准上的标准固定文本校准,同时在A100 GPU上达到1.48x端到端的墙钟解码速度.

articles.title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
articles.content: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无规则判决:LLM合规系统中的诊断和审计监管规则敏感性
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型遵守制度是在以下假设基础上部署的:判决取决于给出的监管规则。 我们直接通过五个模式和20个监管和平台政策领域测试:删除、互换或否定治理规则,同时将案件固定下来,并检查判决是否改变(OCS)或模型内部对合规变化的表示(ICS-delta)。 两者都不尽然:模型的判断往往对所提供的规则产生很大干扰,在此评估的卫兵模型根据其本土分类学的习惯规则调整,是五种模型中最不注意规则和最不准确的,略高于机会(51%,而通用模型为90-92%)。 这反映了比一概忽视更简单的情况:在删除规则改变以前正确的模型预测的情况下,模型确实密切跟踪. 对模型内部表述的更好鼓励或直接干预都无法弥合这一差距。 仅靠准确性并不能确定遵约裁决的依据是所提供的规则。

articles.title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
articles.content: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 调和 SQL:在现实数据库环境中对SQL代理进行合理培训
articles.content_zh: 文本到SQL模型通常被训练成将问题直接映射到静态查询中,而现实世界数据库代理则通过状态,多回合的交互操作与活性数据库——检查计划,执行探针查询,诊断错误,以及修订假说. 这造成了关键的列车-部署不匹配,因为调解这种交互的执行工具只在推论时间引入. 为了弥合这一差距,我们提议建立HarnessSQL,这是一个利用性的培训后框架,在监督的微调和强化学习中保持充分的互动结构。 调和 SQL构建孤立的,可执行的数据库环境与隐藏的处决甲骨文对齐,直接在目标SQL绳带内推出教师,并仅保留经核实的全序SFT的轨迹,然后是执行奖励RL. 横跨蜘蛛2.0-SQLite, 畅通 SQL大幅提升了紧凑模型的执行精度,将Qune3-8B从15.5%提升至45.2%,将Qune3-14B从22.2%提升至54.8%,同时有效地转移到分配外互动基准,如BIRD-Interact和LiveSQL Bench. 我们的调查结果表明,直接在其执行能力范围内培训数据库人员对于掌握复杂、长距离的数据库工作流程至关重要。

articles.title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
articles.content: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoVoice:来自Egocentral多式联运流的主动助词
articles.content_zh: 可穿戴的增强现实(AR)助理正在走向持续的现实世界互动,他们通过第一人称视频和音频来感知用户的活动,并在没有明确要求的情况下及时提供口头指导. 虽然主动的视频助理,口语对话系统,以及以自我为中心的任务理解,每个系统都迅速进步,但现有的系统并没有解决决定何时说话和从连续的第一人称流中说什么的共同问题. 我们介绍了EgoVoice,这是一个培训和评估主动自我中心语言助理的框架。 从HoloAssist真实的人类教官的视频录音中,我们通过源头分离和语音合成来构建干净的音频流,并将每段视频会话转换成一种格式,模型必须在每一时刻决定是保持沉默还是提供口头指导. 我们用我们的数据微调一个全方位LLM,并进一步改进它的主动干预行为,直接优化偏好。 跨越封闭式和开源式模型的实验表明,现有的系统很少产生时机成熟,有意义的主动干预,而EgoVoice则在干预时间,内容相关性,以及人类偏好于零镜头主干线方面产生明显的改善.

articles.title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
articles.content: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 本地范围: 关系本地化 以正确的锁定获取本地地形学
articles.content_zh: Dense reference 通常会根据其语义上与一个问题相似的文本块排序. 这忽略了许多数据系统已经存储的结构,包括分区成员,会话边界,以及原生顺序. 我们提出NaturalScope, 一种当时的标尺法, 用于查询已知的主播和关系。 它代表查询为q - > (A、r、B)。 主锚 A 和 relations r 通过归属选择本地单位,在操作符之前或之后,而目标术语 B 的排名仅与选定范围重叠的块. 内部变体NS-FullQ以满题排名相同候选人. 根据1 024个托盘预算,我们评价从QASPER和LongMemEval获得的200个受控文件和内存记录。 土著 范围达到土著单位召回89.28%的文件和72.50%的记忆,提高了42.75%和22.00个百分点。 NS-FullQ达到了87.78%和68.50%;它与NublicScope的区别是没有定论的,它定位了关系范围界定的主要收益,而不是较短的排名查询。 有了自动的Top-1主锚,记忆召回率下降到35.50%. 因此,当锚定坐标和本土关系可靠时,NublicScope是有效的,但硬范围化继承了本地化界面的错误.

articles.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 托肯鲁特:托肯级LLM高效服务系统 运行
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)的路由在不同的模型中分布推论工作,推进LLM服务的成本质量Pareto前沿. 虽然在会话或查询层粗糙的路由被广泛采用于生产系统,但最近的算法工作显示,精细的路由符号级能够产生巨大的效率和质量收益. 然而,有效提供象征性的路由推论对现有系统构成重大挑战。 以单LLM假设为基础,目前的系统在符号级路由下会遭受严重的步态脱同步和频繁的批次录入延迟,它们也给开发者带来了高执行的复杂性. 为了应对这些挑战,我们设计了Token Router,这是一个高效和开发者友好的服务系统,用于象征性的路由LLM推论。 TokenRouter遵循以请求为中心编程,模式为中心执行的原则:开发人员从单一请求的角度描述路由逻辑,而运行时间为每个LLM发射一个子服务器,发送请求同步. 每个子服务器都使用一个延迟计时器,其最佳的超参数来自系统的数学吞吐模型. 通过各种路由算法,工作量,以及模型对,托肯路特实现了2.01-64.15x的解码吞吐量高于现有系统,大大提升了信使级LLM路由的服务效率. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/thu-nics/Token Router上查阅。

articles.title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
articles.content: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型作为AI研究世界模型
articles.content_zh: AI研究代理人将提出,实施,评估实验的周期自动化,开启了递归自我改进的道路. 然而,它们提出实验的能力超过了在实际环境中进行实验的能力,使结果预测成为在有限的实验预算下持续自我改进的关键能力。 我们作为研究世界模型(RWMs)来调查语言模型,预测各种研究环境中候选干预的结果。 我们的评估利用了来自9个研究环境的2,600多份实验记录,这些研究环境涵盖培训前、培训后和推断,代表了超过171,000个H100 GPU小时的实验。 从实际实验经验中获得的研究知识改进了RWM对同一环境中的无形干预的预测(Spearman + 0.27),并且可以跨环境重复使用. 例如,仅使用OLMo3,Marin和Nanochat的预训经验,与零经验设定相比,RWM在Qune3环境中将选择遗憾减少了78%. 这些好处扩大到在固定选择预算下进行多轮自动研究:拥有内在和跨内在研究知识的RWMs分别提高了15.8%和11.6%。 用于RWMs的13种语言模型的分布表明,增加研究知识比改变模型或增加推理努力更能改进干预排名. 这些调查结果支持作为RWMs的语言模型,并激励为未来的RWM培训积累实验数据.

articles.title: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion
articles.content: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DiffuPlex:通过滚动的蒙面扩散加速全双音节对话框模型
articles.content_zh: 最近全复式的语音对话模型可以同时进行听和说话,但是精细的刻度模型仍然在每个交互框架中自动推进骨干. 我们引入了DiffuPlex,这是一个滚动的蒙面扩散框架,通过在单一主干后预测多个未来的用户和助理帧来减少这种顺序计算. DiffuPlex只消耗每个预测未来的自信前缀,而互动则继续按原帧速率进行. 随着用户语音的到来,它检查相应的用户预测,当交互时,保留已经播放的助手内容,同时只修订未播放的未来. 我们考虑在同一预测器上的两个推论政策:DiffuPlex-LISTEN在预测助手沉默时会消耗多个未来帧,而DiffuPlex-SPEAK也可以消耗预测的助手语音. DiffuPlex在全方位互动和口语评价中大量减少连续主干计算,同时在很大程度上保持互动行为和一般能力。 DiffuPlex-LISTEN和DiffuPlex-SPEAK实现1.46\时间和1.59\时间部署-路径墙点速度,1.61\时间和1.80\时间 核心LM加速,所有测量到的主干引用在80ms交互间隔内完成. 人类评价显示,Listen保留了语音自然和对话质量,而SPEAK保留了语音质量,在语音自然性上有一定的退化.

articles.title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
articles.content: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SciTBERT:一个按时间顺序一致的用于科技语言处理的语言模型家族.
articles.content_zh: 训练有素的变压器模型越来越多地用于研究科技进步. 编码器对纸质或专利文本的调制超过了关于下游分类、回归和科技内邻近任务的通用模型。 然而,这些模型对于研究科学、技术的视时间而定或档案特性及其界面的适用性有限,因为这些预先训练的模型所固有的前瞻和域偏差。 这些限制产生于对公司进行时间和文本来源分配不受限制的培训。 我们介绍SciTBERT:一个由时间顺序一致的BERT派生语言模型组成的家庭,这些模型受过科学论文、专利和高质量的教育网络文本的培训,培训数据截止日期从2013年到2025年每年。 我们还利用纸张和专利引用,以按时间顺序一致的方式培训这些模型,创建了SciTBERT-CI模型家族。 我们发现,即使培训数据受到文书中早年限制的限制,这些模型一般都超过了前一个特定域编码器模型。 为了进一步调查这一类模型能够在多大程度上学习连接科学技术的表示,我们引入了PatRepEval基准,这是一套与专利有关的文本,嵌入了科技界面的任务. 在涵盖论文和专利的各种分类、回归和检索任务中的表现突出表明了使编码器模型表示与其下游任务域分布保持一致的重要性,而且时间顺序一致的编码器可以在没有时间限制的情况下匹配或超过培训过的模型。

articles.title: SteerablePlex: Can We Steer Full-Duplex Models?
articles.content: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak simultaneously, enabling natural interaction, but become increasingly difficult to control as the conversation history grows. When used as user simulators, this lack of control can cause them to deviate from prescribed scenarios and produce unreliable evaluation outcomes. We introduce SimIF-Bench (Simulator Instruction-Following Benchmark), which evaluates whether a conversational model stays within a prescribed scenario and completes multiple goals in the required order. The benchmark reveals that current open-source full-duplex models struggle to follow such constraints. We then introduce a Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO)-based training recipe that enables a full-duplex model to follow textual instructions during an ongoing conversation while maintaining its turn-taking ability. By connecting the resulting SteerablePlex to an asynchronous backend language model that monitors the conversation and provides instructions when needed, we build a more controllable full-duplex user simulator that follows multi-stage constraints more reliably than existing open-source models and GPT-Realtime.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 引导Plex:我们能引导全双模式吗?
articles.content_zh: 完全繁复的语音模型可以同时听和说话,使得自然互动成为可能,但随着对话历史的增长,控制变得越来越困难. 当作为用户模拟器使用时,这种缺乏控制会导致它们偏离规定的情景,产生不可靠的评价结果. 我们引入了SimIF-Bench(模拟指令-后续基准),该基准评价一个对话模式是否停留在规定的情景中,并按规定的顺序完成多个目标. 基准显示,目前的开放源码全复式模型难以遵循这些限制。 然后,我们推出一种基于Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Political Optimation(GDPO)的培训配方,使一个全复式模式能够在持续对话中遵循文本指示,同时保持其接力能力. 通过将由此产生的SefablePlex连接到一个同步的后端语言模型来监控对话并在需要时提供指令,我们构建了一个比现有的开源模型和GPT-Realtime更可靠地遵循多阶段制约的更可控的全复式用户模拟器.

articles.title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
articles.content: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当 KL 组合政策优化中的错火规范化时
articles.content_zh: 为什么取消参考政策 KL 正规化有时会改善群体政策的优化? 这促使人们研究参考政策信息应如何输入与群体相关的最新情况。 我们分析KL和奖励之间的相互作用中的七个潜在失败模式:奖励剪辑后的剩余KL更新,梯度取消后的更新,以及同等奖励的组别;响应长度的KL增长和相对贡献的不平衡;KL集中在少量的符号上;以及当k1被纳入奖励时的取样噪音. 我们提出零分校准政策优化(ZCPO),它使用条件KL测量的相对漂移来校准组内奖励系数,并将其纳入基数代位. 数学推理实验和模拟支持这种设计在我们环境中的有效性.

articles.title: Language-Specific Effects of Tokenizer Choice in Multilingual Language Models
articles.content: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多语言模型中Tokenizer选择的语言特定效果
articles.content_zh: Tokenizer的选择影响了多语种语言的建模,但词汇容量有限,词汇大小往往受到限制:改善某些语言的代表性往往会牺牲其他语言. 因此,我们问,语言之间的象征性选择是否同等重要,目前的文献对此问题没有回答。 为此,我们培训了123种语言模型,它们跨越54种标语。 在主要比较中,建筑,训练大纲,训练台预算,以及优化都是固定的,因此模型只在标注符上有所不同. 我们发现,对于语言模型培训数据较少的语言来说,符号选择更重要:在54个符号中,语言的比特/字节(BPB)的标准偏差随着其模型培训数据份额的减少而增加(Spearman rho = -0.52,在31个训练语言中为0.69,在28个字节中为0.69)。 将语言从象征性培训中分离出来,提高了我们所研究的每一种语言的BPB,对于语言模型培训数据较少的语言来说,惩罚往往更大。 然而,让资源较低的语言获得更大份额的代碼器-培训数据并不无条件地帮助这些语言:在语言模型培训数据方面,平等加权和分配反向分配的比例增加了他们的BPB,特别是在语言模型培训重复数据时。 最后,哪一种内在的标致特性与更好的BPB相关,不同语言间的差异,提供了进一步的证据,证明什么是好的标致特性取决于语言. 我们发现,量化这些属性的衡量标准可以成功地用来预测下游模型的对称BPB排名,建议在培训语言模型之前筛选标语候选人的实用策略.

articles.title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
articles.content: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 排练一切,记住一切:阁楼 - KV 排练 将读什么
articles.content_zh: 许多密钥值(KV)缓存被压缩后,人们才知道要问它们什么:一个缓存用于检索的文档,一个跨请求共享的快速前缀,一个长对话的内存. 流行的方法通过排练来评分KV条目:模型重读上下文并保留它所处理的条目,假设缓存排练其上下文越彻底,就越能记住. 我们显示,在预算紧张的情况下,这种假设是消极的:排练一切,什么都不记得。 在3%的保存比率下,整个上下文的重读保留了 RAULLR的96.5分中的31.5分,在Long Bench的自然文本任务上,它低于完全没有排练的方法. 原因是缓存会保留它所排练的内容:重读会将预算分散到整个上下文中,因此答案自己的条目仅能以几率生存. 和考试前的学生一样,缓存通过测试本身而不是通过重读来记忆更多. 接下来是两项原则:排练将要阅读的内容,排练的尽量多. 我们以Attic-KV(Attic for short)的形式将他们作为即兴表演,这是一次免费的排练,在排练中,模型用引用上下文的回答对自己进行测试,同时用内容适应的量来锁定符号。 只更改排练 提升三个主机 得分有三种不同方式: 仅阁楼是我们在 RULAR 和 Long Bench 的自然文字任务上测试的所有8个场合中最好的无训练方法,并插入基于梯度的 KVgrad 和经过训练的 ReturnKV+, 它将它们提升至17.1和28.1分. 它的优势随着预算的收缩而增长,在3%的保有率下,在完全重读后达到41.9分,压缩速度比整个上下文的重读快.

articles.title: A persistent accuracy ceiling in automated verbal deception detection
articles.content: Automated methods have been proposed to overcome the limitations of human verbal deception detection, but evidence remains fragmented across disciplines. We systematically reviewed 25 years of research (289 reports, 6,136 classification models) and meta-analyzed 3,653 models nested within 97 datasets. Pooled accuracy was 74.4% (95% CI: 71.2%-77.4%) with substantial heterogeneity. Accuracy was driven by methodological quality (ground truth, data source, class balance, evaluation procedure) more than by model complexity: the adoption of embeddings and large language models has not translated into improved predictive performance. Only 12.46% of reports used data with verifiable ground-truth, and only 23.96% of models were evaluated on independent data. The pooled accuracy aligns with meta-analyses of manual approaches, suggesting a ceiling of 70-75%, unlikely to be lifted by current research conventions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自动口头欺骗侦测持续准确性上限
articles.content_zh: 已提出自动化方法来克服人类口头欺骗探测的局限性,但证据在学科中仍然支离破碎. 我们系统地审查了25年的研究(289份报告,6 136个分类模型),并进行了元分析,在97个数据集内嵌入了3 653个模型。 集合精度为74.4%(95% CI:71.2%-77.4%),高度异质性。 精确性的驱动力是方法质量(地面真理,数据来源,类平衡,评价程序)比模型复杂:采用嵌入和大语言模型并没有转化为更好的预测性能. 只有12.46%的报告使用了可核实的地面真实数据,只有23.96%的模型根据独立数据进行了评估。 集合的准确性与人工方法的元分析一致,表明上限为70-75%,目前的研究公约不可能取消。

articles.title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
articles.content: LLM-as-a-Judge is the standard paradigm for NLP evaluation, yet its systemic reliability remains poorly understood despite being widely treated as a deterministic ground truth. We present a comprehensive reliability audit, stresstesting six frontier models across four benchmarks, five prompt formats, two presentation orders, three sampling temperatures, and ten repetitions per condition. Our empirical analysis reveals severe vulnerabilities: verdicts change across identical replications at temperature zero, position-order swaps flip the majority of verdicts on challenging tasks, and the most deterministic judge achieves perfect consistency by trivially repeating incorrect verdicts, agreeing with ground truth only 51% of the time. To formalize these multi-faceted failure modes, we introduce the trustworthy verdict rate (T ), a unified metric capturing the joint probability that an evaluation is reproducible, order-invariant, and accurate. UsingT , we derive a theoretical upper bound on accuracy imposed by position bias and show that reliability is item-specific rather than modellevel. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting from pairwise win-rate to holistic rubric scoring improves trustworthiness more than any single-format prompting intervention, offering an actionable framework for robust NLP evaluation.
