articles.title_zh: 所有判决都不相等:反思LLM 法官可靠性
articles.content_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge是NLP评价的标准范式,但尽管被广泛视为确定性的基础真理,其系统可靠性仍然没有得到很好的理解。 我们提出了全面的可靠性审计,对6个前沿模型进行了压力测试,涉及4个基准、5个快速格式、2个列报命令、3个采样温度和每个条件的10个重复。 我们的经验分析揭示了严重的脆弱性:在零温下,判决在相同的重复中发生改变,位置顺序转换推翻了大多数关于挑战性任务的判断,而最决定性的法官通过轻而易举地重复错误的判决来实现完美的一致性,只同意51%的时间的地面真理。 为了正式确定这些多面的失败模式,我们引入了可信赖的判定率(T),这个统一的度量标准可以捕捉到一个评价是可复制的,命令式的,和准确性的共同概率. 使用T,我们从理论上推导出由位置偏差强加于精度的上限,并显示可靠性是特定项目而不是模型层面. 最后,我们表明,从双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向双向

articles.title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
articles.content: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ILM:一个AI功率讲故事的教育工具
articles.content_zh: 数字技术使伊斯兰叙事更容易获得,但现有的平台为有条理地学习和理解这些故事提供了有限的支持,特别是在阿拉伯语和多语言环境中。 我们介绍ILM,一个先知故事互动教育平台,将阿拉伯语自然语言处理、结构化的知识表现和基于检索的问题生成结合起来。 管理批准的阿拉伯语叙事由知识图形(KG)建构引擎处理,该引擎将实体和叙事关系确定为结构化知识并将其存储,使学习者能够通过视觉故事地图探索故事,并解答由KG产生的基于实体和关系的问题. 另外,一个多语种检索管道从原始叙述中检索相关段落,以产生多种选择和开放式理解问题。 对于开放式问题,一名LLM-as-a-Judge根据检索的段落评价学习者的答案和参考答案,以确定正确性。 该平台还将《古兰经》的内容作为一个单独的浓缩层,允许以来源支持的信息补充选定的叙述。 通过将结构化的知识与基于通道的检索相结合,ILM支持阿拉伯语和多语种内容的叙事探索、理解和评估。 该系统表明,将结构化的知识表现和基于检索的生成结合起来,以支持互动学习伊斯兰叙事是可行的。 可在匿名4open.science/r/mml-5FCF上提供演示。

articles.title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
articles.content: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 何时代理 觉得呢? 通过交叉交易估算的适应性理由
articles.content_zh: 基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理已经显示出在复杂任务方面的强大能力. 它们通常在每次行动之前,在整个互动轨迹中进行推理。 然而,推理可能并非每一回合都有必要,因为早先提出的推理可以继续支持以后的行动。 因此,关键的挑战是如何确定现有推理何时仍然足够,何时需要采取新的推理步骤,而不依赖成本高昂的基于一代的核查。 我们发现,在删除其他推理之后,随后参照行动的可能性下降,这密切跟踪这些行动是否可以继续被收回,因为先前的推理为估计交叉转折行动支助提供了有效和轻度的信号。 基于这一看法,我们提议通过交叉估算(RACE)进行合理适应,这是适应剂推理的培训方法。 RACE引入了一种以 " 可能 " 为指南的渐进式理性覆盖检测(LoGiC)程序,该程序逐步确定其排除对当前和随后的参考行动影响有限的推理转折。 由此产生的清除信号被纳入监督的微调和辅助强化学习,使政策能够学习何时理性,何时直接行动。 对四个具有代表性的代理基准的广泛实验表明,RACE在维持或改进任务业绩的同时,大大减少了推理成本。

articles.title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自然语言到以 LLM 为基础的先令逻辑化
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)重新对自动形式化产生了兴趣. 然而,当第一命令逻辑(FOL)被认为是目标形式主义时,这个领域仍然缺乏统一的任务制定和系统的调查. 本文述及这一差距:我们首先通过区分《肿瘤提取法》和《逻辑翻译法》,为FOL-自动化任务提供原则定义,说明其汇合性如何模糊(交叉研究)评价;我们审查现有数据集、评价衡量尺度和基于LLM的方法,包括微调、提示和基于核查的改进;我们确定基准、语义评价、肿瘤认知方法和端到端应用方面的公开挑战。

articles.title: InterviewPlayground: A Simulation Environment for Evaluating AI Interviewers
articles.content: Increasingly, AI interviewers are being developed to elicit open-ended responses in applications like market research, public polling, preference elicitation, and social science research. However, evaluating AI interviewers is challenging because they function in extended, multi-turn interactions where they must adapt to participant behaviors. To address this need, we develop InterviewPlayground, a simulation environment for evaluating AI interviewers using simulated study participants whose behaviors are grounded in social theory. Simulated studies in InterviewPlayground produce an InterviewReportCard, which assesses the performance of AI interviewers using a suite of validated measures. To test whether our simulation-based evaluations predict performance with human participants, we conduct 15 real qualitative studies with five AI interviewers, three interview topics, and 450 human participants and compare them to simulated studies in InterviewPlayground. We find that AI interviewer performance in InterviewPlayground predicts performance in human studies with an average Pearson correlation of 0.86 across 12 measures, and the simulated interactions from InterviewPlayground reproduce key findings from behavioral analysis of AI interviewers in the human studies. Together, these findings support the validity of InterviewPlayground in assessing AI interviewer performance and examining potential failure modes. Our work contributes a simulation environment for AI interviewers supported with empirical validation, and more broadly, a roadmap for future work to develop validated, simulation-based evaluations of conversational AI systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 访谈 游戏场:评估AI访谈者的模拟环境
articles.content_zh: 越来越多的AI访谈者正在开发,以便在市场研究、民意测验、偏好招揽和社会科学研究等应用方面获得开放的响应。 然而,评价AI访谈者是具有挑战性的,因为他们在扩展的多回合互动中发挥作用,必须适应参与者的行为。 为了满足这一需要,我们开发了InterviewPlayground,一个模拟环境,用以利用模拟研究参与者来评价AI访谈者,他们的行为基于社会理论. InterviewPlayground的模拟研究制作了"InterviewReportCard",通过一套经过验证的措施评估AI访谈者的表现. 为了测试我们的模拟评价是否预测人类参与者的性能,我们进行了15项真正的定性研究,包括5个AI访谈者,3个访谈话题,以及450个人类参与者,并把它们比作InterviewPlayground的模拟研究. 我们发现InterviewPlayground的AI访谈者表现预测了人类研究中的性能,平均皮尔逊相关性为0.86,跨12个度量衡,来自InterviewPlayground的模拟互动复制了人类研究中AI访谈者的行为分析的关键发现. 这些调查结果共同支持了InterviewPlayground在评估AI面试者表现和审查潜在失败模式方面的有效性. 我们的工作为AI访谈者提供了模拟环境,并辅之以经验验证,更广泛地说,为今后制定对对话AI系统进行有效、模拟评价的工作提供了路线图。

articles.title: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 审查LLM中的社会归属 理由: 理论指导的检验方法
articles.content_zh: 在社会技术体系中,大语言模型(LLMS)日益被运用,社会归属,将外部事件归因于代理人社会行为的起因和原因的推理过程,发挥着关键作用. 这些过程涉及对社会事业、责任和对代理人的指责/信用的判断。 虽然归属模型通过归属理论在社会心理学和认知学中得到了很好的研究,但社会归属在AI中仍然没有得到充分的探讨,尤其是LLM社会推理. 本文为LLM社会归属的首次系统探索. 我们的工作重点是责任和责任归属,审查目前法学硕士的判断及其内部机制。 以归属论为指导,我们构建了一个由Vignette子集组成的社会归属基准,该子集基于归属论研究的经典情景,而现实子集基于现实世界的社会叙事,产生7,639个责任/指责的判断问题. 在此基础上,我们评估了32项具有代表性的有限责任措施和5项基本非有限责任清单基线。 为了进一步探索LLM判断过程所依据的内部机制,我们开发了一种基于检验的方法,以调查5个关键归属层面的潜在空间表现及其与人类社会归属层面相比对LLM判断的影响的一致性。 我们的研究结果表明,目前的有限责任管理办法与人的责任和责难判断有可衡量但不完整的一致,与此同时,这种一致与模型规模是正相关联的。 一些归属维度从LLM隐藏状态中的特定位置上系统地解码,它们对于最终判断的影响与人类归属理论所显示的一致. 数据集和相关代码见https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench。

articles.title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
articles.content: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Agentic-TTT:测试时间培训政策
articles.content_zh: 测试时间训练(TTT)利用从测试输入中得出的信号来调整LLM的参数,并且可以在预先指定的场合,如海事组织竞赛或指定的开放问题中作出显著的改进. 通过将部署经验转化为参数更新,TTT为模型层面的自我改进提供了直接机制. 然而,TTT并非普遍有益:每个TTT算法在不同的场合工作,采用不合适的方法可能会浪费测试时间计算甚至损害模型性能. 因此,这种参数级的自我改进需要代理:模型必须决定何时需要TTT,引用哪种算法,以及是否可以重新使用现有的技能. 为了填补这一空白,我们引入了Agentic-TTT,它学习了管理这些决定的试验时间政策。 Agentic-TTT将TT程序变成可调用的工具,将积累的技能视为一个不断发展的部署环境,并利用从其决定中观察到的效用收益来培训其政策. 根据我们的基准,Agentic-TTT几乎比主干模型的功用翻了一番,学会用功值与计算值进行交换,并概括到培训期间所未见的领域。 这些结果共同指向自主自我改进:能够决定如何从自己的部署经验中学习的模式.

articles.title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
articles.content: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DataVista:分析关于数据视频理解的多式联运LLMs
articles.content_zh: 数据视频是一种将数据可视化与视频叙事相结合的媒体形式,广泛应用于新闻报道和商业分析. 与一般的视频理解相比,数据视频理解更强调从动画图表中准确读取数据,将跨图表和时间的证据整合,以及理解叙事组织和视觉设计如何传递信息. 然而,现有的基准既针对一般录像,也针对静态图表,而数据录像了解情况尚未得到系统评价。 我们提出DataVista,这是数据视频理解的第一个基准,包含961个真实世界数据视频和6 775个评价问题,在一个三级渐进能力框架(数据感知,时间推理,叙事理解)下组织,涉及五个主题领域的10个精细问题类型. 对19个主流MLLMs的系统评价表明,表现最好的模型双子座-3.1-Pro达到70.0%的整体精度,仍然远低于人类专家的性能,模型在因果理性和叙述结构上表现最差. 增加帧数和增加字幕,主要有利于数据感知和时间推理,在叙事理解方面收益有限. 对模型反应的进一步分析确定了图读、证据判断和指令理解方面的典型故障模式。 该基准可在https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista查阅。

articles.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
articles.content: Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 专门决定模式与一般用途有限责任公司:为Jev全知识、理性和多种语言任务制定基准
articles.content_zh: Jev是一个"System One"模型,它返回给定选项中的选择,而不是生成文本. 我们研究这种专门决策模式如何与通用大语言模式(LLMs)相比较。 我们评价Jev的13个多重选择基准,包括知识、推理和多语种理解,并将其与19个法学硕士进行三级比较:前沿、代表性和小型。 Jev在知识和常识基准方面与前沿LLMs具有竞争力,并在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上获得最佳得分. 在数学之外,它的表现也超过了最具代表性的LLM和所有的小型LLM. 然而,它落后于数学词问题:在MathQA上,它比边框中位数低17.7分,得分低于所有19个LLMs. 这些结果表明,专门决策模式能够与主要依赖知识、但并不依赖需要多步骤计算的决定的通用有限责任项目相匹配。

articles.title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
articles.content: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MindFlow:Mind Supernet 为研究创意提供动力思维流
articles.content_zh: 研究思想创新是科学进步的根本动力,然而仍然难以以可伸缩和可控的方式产生和评价. 这一挑战在于其固有的无限制和多重目标的性质,即各种想法应平衡新颖性、可信性和可行性。 虽然最近基于LLM的方法通过精心设计的提示或代理管道取得了进展,但它们受到预先确定的静态思想工作流程的限制。 为了解决这个局限性,我们提议MindFlow,这个框架明确提出思想作为Mind的图形结构流,它由模块思维操作员组成,由概率思维超网模拟. 鉴于一个研究课题,一个控制器动态地采样思考流来生成候选的想法. 这个开放式问题采用基于锦标赛的相对排名来优化,使控制器逐渐倾向于更高质量的思维流. 我们进一步采用了一项评价协议,联合评估问题发现和解决问题,超越了所有权或抽象判断。 在许多主题上,MindFlow显示出它作为一个明确,可控和可选择的研究思想创新者的优越性.

articles.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MiMo-V2.6:加强自我改善学习
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)是推动大型基础模式走向自我完善的核心培训模式. 这份报告介绍了MiMo-V2.6系列,这是一个通过缩放RL计算来推动模型智能前沿的全能模式家族. 在重新开放之前,我们进行关于一项广泛的多式联运文书的中期培训,以提供充分的探索空间,并在经过预先培训的混合-西南亚结构上建立一个坚实的基础设施,以支持随后的扩展。 我们按三个维度进行RL计算:(1) 批量较大,吞吐量更高,同步训练每步消耗1 568个样本和2.7-3.7B个信使,其上下文长度可达1M;(2) 在代理吊带的混合下,更多样化和复杂的环境,跨越代码,一般,视觉和网络领域;(3) 通过分组代理分级,通过更精确的奖励信号来计算长视距任务,并将模型导向更短,更象征性的解决方案. 为了保持训练在规模上的稳定,我们冻结了MOE路由器,并建立了多层防御,防止奖励黑客入侵. 我们进一步建设混合任务代理RL的基础设施,包括统一的轨迹代表、高通币多框架推出、脱钩控制和数据飞机以及培训参考一致性。 我们开放培训动态、RL环境和RL框架,以便利复制和进一步研究规模化RL和模型自我改进。

articles.title: When History Helps and Hurts: Selective History Use across Multimodal Turns
articles.content: Reliable multimodal interaction depends on selective use of conversational history: an earlier question may remain relevant while its previous answer is outdated, whereas a current request may depend on historical evidence despite conflicting new observations. Existing multi-turn evaluations rarely separate these history-use demands from underlying question difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce ReTurn, a benchmark of 7,000 base tasks spanning visual and audio evidence for evaluating selective history use. For task-carrying history, Reconfirm/Reground require applying a historical question to current media while varying historical agreement; for evidence-carrying history, Retrieve/Rebind require answering a current question using historical media while varying current-media competition. Each pair preserves the target question, media, and answer. Tasks support open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation, with matched single-turn counterparts serving as answerability references. Across 13 omni-modal, vision-language, and audio-language models, median model-level open-ended accuracy falls from 93.7% with direct input to 72.3% in conversation. Behavioral probes show that high question recall can coexist with weaker task application, while competing media can redirect answers away from historical targets. Supervised adaptation yields only partial gains. ReTurn provides a controlled framework for assessing whether multimodal models select and use the historical information required by each request.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当历史帮助和伤害:选择历史 跨多式转向
articles.content_zh: 可靠的多式联运互动取决于有选择地使用对话历史:早先的问题可能仍然相关,而先前的答案已经过时,而目前的请求可能取决于历史证据,尽管新的观察有冲突。 现有的多回合评价很少将这些历史使用要求与基本的问题困难分开。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了ReTurn这一基准,该基准有7 000个基本任务,涉及视觉和音频证据,用于评估选择性历史使用情况。 对于任务承载历史,重新确认/重新确定需要将历史问题应用于当前媒体,而历史协议各不相同;对于证据承载历史,重新确认/重新确定则需要使用历史媒体回答当前问题,同时不同的当前媒体竞争. 每对都保留目标问题,媒体,和答案. 任务支持开放式和多选择评价,配对的单回合对口单位作为可回答参考。 在13个全方位模式、视觉语言和音频语言模型中,中位模型的开放式精度从93.7%直接输入下降到72.3%。 行为探测器显示,高题召回可以与更弱的任务应用共存,而竞争的媒体可以将答案从历史目标中重新定向. 监督的适应只产生部分收益。 Return为评估多式联运模型是否选择和使用每项请求所要求的历史信息提供了一个控制框架。

articles.title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
articles.content: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 项目温室:全面开放和主权代理搜索的进展
articles.content_zh: 温室项目代表了我们对一个简单论文的探索: 我们认为,只有有限的计算资源,才有可能建立完全开放和主权的代理搜索模式。 作为第一个里程碑,我们描述了如何使用简单的两步制配方,即从头开始进行预先训练,然后进行有监督的微调,仅从常用的数据集开始,来构建一个具有竞争性的点解码器唯一的重新排序器。 与文献中的主导方法相反,我们并不依靠第三方现有的开放量级骨干,因此我们完全控制了模式训练,从头到尾. 我们用很少的GPU完成了大部分实验。 本报告阐述了我们方法的重要性和益处,我们分享了能够透明、独立地复制示范培训各个方面的文物。 除了记录我们努力的数据、代码和配置之外,我们还为我们加格勒模式的家族释放检查站,展示我们的方法的可行性,并为验证我们更广泛的论文提供第一步。

articles.title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
articles.content: For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 事件- Central 内存, 包含长期对话代理的 Query- Aware 图增强功能
articles.content_zh: 对于持续和个性化的对话代理人来说,记忆系统可以通过存储过去的互动和检索相关信息,使他们能够在漫长的历史中记忆、更新和理性。 现有的内存系统一般遵循两个范式:平面结构内存和以图为基础的内存. 前者为轻量级,但留下事件关系和状态更新隐含,后者则明确模拟内存结构,但产生额外的构建成本,并在漫长的历史中引入无关关系. 为解决这些局限性,我们提出QGMem,这是一个以人类记忆为动机的新记忆构建和激活框架,其中经验被组织成事件,与查询相关的事件通过图表作为工作记忆的模式. QGMem将长对话历史转换为事件索引原子记忆单位,保存个人经验,将相关单位整合为动态记忆痕迹,保留状态轨迹和当前状态. 当一个查询到达时,混合内存检索会收集互补的候选记忆,而查询-意识的重新排序会激活最相关的单位作为紧凑的工作记忆. 为了揭露工作内存中的关系依赖性并支持冲突意识推理,QGMem将工作内存组织为局部图,然后作为图符号编码,与文字工作内存一起提供给LLM,以便在生成答案时提高证据的利用率. 6个基准的实验验证了框架,并显示出在检索、多跳证据构成、冲突解决以及具有紧凑背景和适度推论成本的超长对话推理方面的持续收益。

articles.title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
articles.content: Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 并非每个改变都是必要的:大语言模型中的可回收漂流
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型中的机器不学习旨在消除不需要的知识,同时保留模型的剩余能力. 虽然现有方法使用保留目标或限制编辑时,但实现预期的遗忘水平仍可能留下损害非目标行为的附带变化。 我们的回收比较表明,其中一些变化可以扭转,同时保留观察到的忘记业绩。 在这项工作中,我们提出 " 学习项目 " (PTP-U)建议,该框架将目标明确的遗忘与恢复非目标能力结合起来。 PTP-U首先应用局部分析编辑削弱目标知识协会,然后将非目标产出分布与原模型的分布相协调,以恢复能力,同时保持固定的遗忘限制. 这两个阶段都服务于一个共同目标:满足遗忘的要求,同时保持非目标任务的流利生成和业绩。 从三个基准来看,PTP-U在评估方法之间实现了最强的遗忘保留权衡,达到81.22%-91.03%的遗忘,同时平均保持94.20%的非目标用途。 相匹配的忘记时,PTP-U始终保留较高的非目标用途.

articles.title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
articles.content: Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决策模式能理解Stance吗? 评估Jev对一般用途有限责任公司
articles.content_zh: Stance检测需要识别作者对特定目标的态度,有时是基于对话背景. Jev是专为结构化决策而设计的专门决策模型,它为通用大语言模型(LLMs)提供了一种替代. 在这项工作中,我们用两个姿态检测数据集——VAST(英语文本)和ZS-CSD(中文对话)来评价Jev,将其与四个通用LLM和两个微调模型进行比较. 结果显示,Jev在VAST上实现了竞争性表现,匹配了GPT-5.6,并优于其他通用LLM. 但是,它落后于ZS-CSD更强大的法学硕士,特别是在区别偏好和反对方面。 进一步的分析表明,这种限制可能与理解答复关系和立场方向有关,而不只是对话时间。 这些调查结果突出了Jev在定位探测方面的潜力和局限性。

articles.title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System
articles.content:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically.
  In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents.
  This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从LLM-Chats到自主AI代理系统的LLM-集成应用程序的形式
articles.content_zh:
大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地作为组件嵌入软件系统,在Chatbot,副驾驶,检索加载生成,工作流程,编码代理和AI代理等标签下营销. 这些标签是表示真正的建筑形式还是用作品牌,尚未得到系统的评估。
在被调查的资料来源中,标签确实带有建筑内容,最明显的是供应商的使用:副驾驶表示一个路由器-工作架构,在逐步用户确认下运行一个主机应用程序,而最近转向标签代理时恰逢AI计划多步执行,用户只看到结果. 四个主要供应商的编码代理商共享一个架构,一个原因和动作的环路授权给子代理商.
本次调查描述了7种反复出现的表格--LLM聊天,自定义代理,检索-增强生成(RAG),AI-增强工作流程,副驾驶,编码代理,以及部分代理RAG-在代理和工具的共同词汇中. 每个都具有四个结构维度的特征(代理RAG只有部分):建筑模式,执行控制和用户干预点,每个任务代理呼叫的次数,以及工具使用. 22个系统从研究出版物和供应商文件中得到说明,说明这些系统的理由,并显示其达到极限之处。

articles.title: GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GRPO 网络 辍学:网上强化学习推出较少
articles.content_zh: GRPO等强化学习(RL)方法大大改进了大型语言模型推理,但经常受到政策 en崩溃的困扰:采样多样性的丧失削弱了探索,限制了进一步的改进. 现有方法要么通过算法层面的干预,如奖励修改和Entropy/KL正规化,要么通过象征性的重新加权来解决这一问题。 我们研究了一个互补的视角:通过变革也可以缓解肽的崩溃,而变革产生的推出有助于政策的更新。 根据同样的抽样预算,并非所有的推广都对更新有积极的贡献,有选择地将某些项目排除在外可以改善学习。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用GRPODropout:在标准更新之前,我们采用一种简单的策略,有选择地消除少数高概率的正面优势推广,并消除最近者保留的好处。 为了激励这种设计,我们开发了一种推出级理论分析,指导方法设计和门槛选择. 该方法仅改变推广用途,增加了可忽略不计的计算间接费用。 实验显示精度高于原GRPO和更高的演員 en,同时使用较少的推出样本进行更新,说明"少是多". 这项工作使人们深入了解RL推出的使用:移除一些推出可以提高性能. 代码见https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/。

articles.title: Detecting Spin in Clinical Trials with Large Language Models
articles.content: Spin in clinical trials includes reporting practices that distort the presentation of results. This is particularly critical in medicine, where spin is present in more than 50% of randomized controlled trials that fail to reach statistical significance. The comparison of primary and reported outcomes is crucial for detecting several types of spin, including outcome switching. We used 300 pairs of outcomes labeled with semantic similarity to develop a system for automatic detection of outcome switching. We evaluated baseline text similarity models and open-source LLMs using generated similarity scores and the Youden index to determine the classification threshold. The proposed approach involves prompt engineering, classification based on token probabilities, and majority voting for the final decision. The results on the test set of 2,496 examples with an F1 score of 0.78 and an accuracy of 0.90 outperform baseline text similarity models but trail behind fine-tuned versions of BERT. We used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified instances and manually assessed their quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在大语言模型临床试验中检测自旋
articles.content_zh: 在临床试验中自转包括扭曲结果列报的报告做法。 这一点在医学中特别重要,因为50%以上的随机控制试验没有达到统计意义。 对主要结果和报告结果进行比较对于发现几种类型的旋转,包括结果转换至关重要。 我们用300对标注语义相似的结果来开发一个自动检测结果切换的系统. 我们利用生成的相似性分数和Youden指数评估了基线文本相似性模型和开源LLMs,以确定分类阈值。 拟议办法涉及迅速工程、基于象征性概率的分类以及对最后决定的多数表决。 测试组的2,496例,F1得分0.78,精度0.90超过基线文本相似性模型,但落后于BERT的微调版本. 我们使用LLMS来为分类事件生成自然语言解释,并人工评估其质量.

articles.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
articles.content: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Memento 3: 通过反射规则书进行模型式递归自我改进
articles.content_zh: 学会在陌生的环境中行动,需要代理人推断世界是如何运作的,并随着新证据的到来修改这种理解. 然而有限的观测可以支持多种世界模型,这些模型可以解释过去的相互作用,但预测在看不见的状态下的不同结果. 我们以Memento系列为基础,引入Memento 3,使冷冻的LLM剂能够通过外部记忆不断学习清晰的世界模型. 该剂维持一个自然语言的规则书作为持久的语义记忆,记录关于环境动力学的可修改的假设,同时留下未知的方面不够精确. 它将这个规则书汇编成可执行代码,用于预测和规划. 通过不断循环的观察,反射,规则修订,编译和核查,代理商使用预测错误来完善规则书及其代码. 更新的代码只有在LLM判断它忠实于规则书时被接受,并且细胞精确重播复制所观察到的过渡. 我们将此过程作为递归自我改进(RSI)的基于模型的路径来调查: 代理人自主探索环境,修改其世界模型,并使用经过核实的更新来指导后续的相互作用和学习,而基础LLM仍然固定. 人口扩展维持多个平行的世界模型,共享互动证据,并利用其预测指导探索. 在ARC-AGI-3上,单型代理清理了所有25个公共游戏的每个关卡,实现了100.0的平均相对人类动作效率(RHAE),并使用了人类动作计数的44%. 在一个Atari Pong的案例研究中,一个学习的反馈控制器在三个评价的片段中每集胜21:0,开局不同,不再使用LLM调用.

articles.title: Easy to anticipate, hard to compute: boundary dependence finds the computed outputs that entropy patching misses
articles.content: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) group bytes into patches and run their large global model once per patch. BLT starts a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high, so global compute goes where the next byte is hard to predict. We show that this rule has a systematic blind spot: positions whose type is predictable but whose value must be computed, such as the number after "=" in a worked math solution. Under tight patch budgets, entropy-triggered layouts skip these positions, and accuracy on them collapses. In Meta's BLT-1B with patch starts on 10% of bytes, the entropy rule puts a patch start at 16% of the computed results in GSM8K solutions and gets 19.0% of them exactly right; a boundary after each "=" at the same patch count gets 51.8%, and entropy combined with a label-free boundary-dependence signal gets 67.1% (default layout at 26% of bytes: 76.8%). The gap survives adapting BLT-1B to the budget with low-rank fine-tuning (32.9% vs 72.7%, three runs per rule, paired p < 1e-200) and grows with model size in byte models trained from scratch at a 10% budget: at 1M, 12M and 50M parameters, boundary dependence beats entropy on final answers by -1.6, +10.1 and +19.8 points, and at 50M it gets 35.9% of computed results against 13.9% (3 seeds each). BLT's entropy-jump rule helps neither target at 50M. The entropy trigger of Scratchpad Patching is likewise indistinguishable from random scratchpads on final answers (5.6% vs 5.9%, 5 seeds), while answer-start scratchpads give 38.1%. The effect is specific to computed values: copies and lookups gain little, and values the model cannot compute gain nothing. Boundary dependence, the rise in the model's own loss when a patch start is removed, measured per two-byte context, finds these positions without labels: combined with entropy it beats the hand-written rule on computed results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 容易预测, 难以计算 : 边界依赖 找到 Entropy 补丁缺失的计算输出
articles.content_zh: 字节级语言模型如Byte Latent Transformer(BLT)组字节成补丁,每补丁一次运行其大型全局模型. BLT启动一个小模型的下一个字节 en音高的补丁,因此全球计算会进入下一个字节难以预测的地方. 我们显示,这一规则有一个系统性的盲点:其类型可以预测但必须计算其价值的位置,例如工作数学解决方案中"="之后的数字. 在紧凑的补丁预算下,Entropy-triggered布局跳过这些位置,其上的精确度会崩溃. 在Meta的带补丁的BLT-1B起始于10%的字节上,Entropy规则将一个补丁起始于GSM8K解决方案计算结果的16%,并获得19.0%的完全正确;在同一补丁计数的每个"="之后的边界得到51.8%,与无标签边界依赖信号相结合的Entropy得到67.1%(默认布局在字节的26%:76.8%). 差距继续存在,通过低级微调使BLT-1B适应预算(32.9%对72.7%,每条规则运行三次,p < 1e-200),并以10%的预算从零开始训练的字节模型模型的模型体积扩大:在1M、12M和50M参数上,边界依赖比最终答案高-1.6、+10.1和+19.8分,在50M得到35.9%的计算结果,而13.9%(每个种子3个)。 BLT的Entropy-jump规则对50M的目标都没有帮助. Scratchpad Patching 的 Entropy 触发器同样与最终答案上的随机刮片(5.6%对5.9%,5个种子)无法区分,而答案启动刮片则给出38.1%. 该效果是计算值的特异性:复制件和查找件得到的不多,而值模型不能计算得无益. 边界依赖,当一个补丁开始被移除时,模型自身损失的增加,按二字节上下文进行测量,发现这些位置没有标签:结合 en,它会在计算结果上击败手写规则.

articles.title: From Sparse Representations to Behavioral Insights for Multimodal Depression Assessment
articles.content: Multimodal depression assessment offers a promising approach to analyzing behavioral patterns associated with depression. However, existing methods often rely on dense and opaque multimodal representations, making it difficult to interpret the behavioral patterns underlying their predictions. In this work, we introduce BehavDep, a sparse factor-based framework that decomposes multimodal behavioral representations into sparse latent factors and associates them with behaviorally meaningful concepts through a semantic bridge. To address the mismatch between user-level annotations and heterogeneous video-level behaviors, BehavDep further learns video-level depression tendency scores under weak supervision and aggregates information across multiple observations for user-level assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BehavDep achieves the best overall assessment performance while revealing complementary modality contributions, heterogeneous behavioral patterns across observations, and prediction responses to concept-level editing. These results show that BehavDep provides a structured and interpretable approach to analyzing multimodal behavioral representations for depression assessment.

articles.title_zh: 从Sparse代表到多式联运萧条评估行为观察
articles.content_zh: 多式联运抑郁症评估为分析与抑郁症有关的行为模式提供了一个很有希望的办法。 然而,现有方法往往依赖密集和不透明的多式联运表示,因此难以解释其预测背后的行为模式。 在这部作品中,我们引入了BehavDep, 这个基于要素的简陋框架,它通过语义桥将多模式行为表现分解为稀疏的潜在因素,并将其与行为有意义的概念联系起来. 为了解决用户级说明与不同视频级行为之间的不匹配,BehavDep进一步学习视频级抑郁症趋势在薄弱监管下得分,并汇总跨多个观测的信息,供用户级评估. 广泛的实验表明,BehavDep实现了最佳的总体评估业绩,同时揭示了互补模式的贡献,跨观测的不同行为模式,以及对概念层面编辑的预测反应. 这些结果显示,BehavDep为分析抑郁症评估的多模式行为表现提供了一种有条理和可解释的方法.

articles.title: DPPM: Dual-Path Parametric Memory for Personalized Language Models
articles.content: Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DPPM: 个性化语言模型的双片参数内存
articles.content_zh: 长期个性化需要语言模型使用交互历史来跟踪用户在会话中的偏好. 参数内存将这个相互作用历史编码为模型参数或适配器,减少了将其纳入推论上下文的需要. 然而,独立的上下文汇编没有指明跨会集,而经常性的更新会削弱早先的证据. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用双面参数记忆。 它的证据路径直接集合了互动历史的表示,以保存早期的证据,而其德尔塔路径则依序更新一个关联状态以捕捉变化. 利用这两种产出,可以产生符合历史条件的LORA适配器,将证据积累与有秩序的修订结合起来。 在多个骨干部门中,DPM的表现超过了评估的基线,PersonaMem-v2达到54.22%,PrefEval达到86.79%。 这些结果表明,DPM为跨会场个性化参数记忆提供了简单有效的设计选择.

articles.title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
articles.content: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.

articles.title_zh: 路由器 Interp: 了解专家运行混合中叠加的专业
articles.content_zh: Sparse Mixture of Experient(MoE)模型比稠密模型更高效的尺度,其途径是将路标引向只用于处理一小部分路标的模块化专家网络. 教育部模型绩效的一个主要假设是,每位专家在一个单一、连贯的领域中拥有特殊性。 然而,假设这一假设的可解释性努力一般都没有成功。 我们提出和提出一个替代说法的证据,我们称之为 " 超专业假说 " (SSH):专家专门从事一种由精细特征而不是一个广泛领域组成的脱节联盟。 利用SSH,我们引入了路由器Interp,一种解释专家路由的方法,它能识别Sparse自动编码器的特征,最能预测路由决定,并产生统一的自然语言解释. 在gpt-oss-20b上, RouterInterp 解释专家的路由,用$\sim}65%=$ 检测精度高于先前的以符号统计为基础的方法. 这项工作为更准确地解释专家的路线提供了一种可扩展的方法,并增进了我们对基础模型以前无法解释的部分的理解。

articles.title: Same Outcome, Different Evidence: Intent Recovery in LLM Safety Evaluation
articles.content: Safety evaluations of large language models commonly summarize harmful-output behavior with attack success rate (ASR). Yet the same non-harmful outcome can arise for very different reasons. A model may recover a harmful task and refuse it, fail to recover the task, or respond to something else entirely. Distinguishing these cases becomes especially important under intent-obscuring prompts, where a low ASR does not reveal whether the evaluated task was actually engaged. To make this distinction explicit, we pair ASR with operative understanding rate (UR), which measures whether a response both identifies the evaluated task and treats it as the task to be answered. Across interfaces, this paired view reveals substantial variation hidden by ASR: similar ASR values can correspond to sharply different recovery rates. Controlled English reconstructions show that recovery consistently improves as compressed prompts become more explicit, whereas ASR does not follow the same pattern. A complementary contrast comes from FormalLogic, where high recovery can still coincide with frequent harmful assistance. Together, these results show that non-harmful outcomes are not equally informative about model safety, motivating the joint reporting of intent recovery and ASR in LLM safety evaluation. Code and experiment inputs are available at https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 相同结果,不同证据:LLM安全评价中的有意恢复
articles.content_zh: 对大型语言模型的安全评价通常总结有害的输出行为和攻击成功率(ASR). 然而,同样无害的结果可能出于非常不同的原因。 模型可能回收有害的任务并拒绝,无法回收任务,或者完全对别的东西作出反应. 区分这些案件在意向不明的提示下变得特别重要,因为低度的ASR无法显示所评价的任务是否实际参与。 为了明确这一区分,我们将ASR与业务理解率(UR)合并,后者衡量一项答复是否既确定了评估的任务,又将其视为有待答复的任务。 纵观界面,这种对齐的视图揭示了ASR隐藏的巨大差异:类似的ASR值可以对应截然不同的回收率. 受控制的英语重建表明,随着压缩的提示更加明确,复苏情况持续改善,而ASR则不遵循同样的模式。 一种互补的对比来自正规的Logic,那里高恢复率仍然与频繁的有害援助相吻合。 这些结果表明,无危害的结果对模式安全没有同等的信息,促使联合报告意图恢复和LLM安全评价中的ASR。 代码和实验投入见https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS.

articles.title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.

articles.title_zh: 思考内涵:LLMs继续思考 当告诉不要
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越带有明显的"思维模式",然而其对应的"无思维"却受到了远为少的注意. 我们沿着两个轴心研究LLMs的无思维行为. (单位:千美元) 如何度量无思量. 前作一般通过残疾思维模式或无长痕迹等代词定义无思维. 这些代词不可靠:残废的思维模式可能仍然会释放推理,而长的痕迹可能包含填充物而不是真实的推论. 相反,我们把每项答复正常化为预先回答的追踪和最后答复,并在三个层面进行评估:(一) 空想 严格只回答遵守率; (二)对问题与预先回答的跟踪的相似性进行指示-意识到问题-前回答的相关性; (三)LLM-as judge Expressive Information rate for 明显明确推论. 这些衡量标准加在一起,可以区分只回答输出,相关但非暗示文本,以及明确的推论. (b) 国家 任务和模式之间如何不思议? 我们评价了六次关于6个布尔语、多选择和开放式问题的有限责任措施的发言。 我们认为,明确的无思想控制不能可靠地消除明显的推论。 模型反之显示"思考因诺蒂亚":即使在严格的控制下,明确的推论也持续存在,随着解答空间的打开而变得更加普遍. 在布尔和多重选择任务方面,准确性仍然稳定,而开放式任务则显示在只回答遵守和任务准确性之间作出权衡。 在回答空格中重写同样的问题表明,提供候选答案使得只回答的答复更容易产生. 这些结论将无思维能力确定为非三角能力:不能仅从模型设置或指令中假定停止明确推理,而应当与推理能力一道进行系统评价。
